title: Video Editor - Ecommerce Brand
description:
Hey, thank you for checking out our job post. You are already awesome.



THE ROLE:

The world has changed and video rules. So, we’re looking for somebody who truly enjoys producing videos to join us full-time. You'll be editing short-form video and image ads primarily for Meta and TikTok, working with various media (e.g. UGC footage) and clear briefs provided by the team.



This includes:

- Editing short-form videos

- Adding captions, motion graphics, transitions, b-roll, and sound effects where appropriate

- Create engaging edits that improve viewer retention

- Maintain a consistent editing style and brand identity

- Collaborate with the team to improve video performance and engagement

- Organise project files and deliver videos on schedule



ABOUT US

We are a travel accessories company with a mission to redefine the space by creating products targeted at families that are both stylish and practical, and by providing the best customer care. We have big ambitions, so we work hard, but we also take care of each other because, after all, teamwork makes the dream work.



YOU ARE

* A good eye for detail and composition. Where others might overlook a small issue, you enjoy finding them and cleaning them up

* Have great English

* Skilled in video/image editing tools (i.e. Canva, Capcut Desktop, etc)

* Experience with AI platforms (e.g. ChatGPT and Claude)

* Hungry to learn. You’ll need to keep up with trends in software and social media to make ads that convert

* Research obsessed. Every day we need to follow top e-commerce brands and performance marketers

* You have social media accounts and access to a VPN

* Always reliable and punctual

* Enthusiastic with a can-do attitude





It’s a tough gig. But…



WHY YOU’LL WANT THIS POSITION:

* A friendly and professional work environment

* Opportunities for growth and learning

* Regular constructive feedback to help improve your skills

* A fun team

* Regular payment



REQUIREMENTS

* Available for 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

* Available during UK working hours

* Location can be anywhere in the world, as long as you have reliable Internet access

* Proven video and image editing skills

* Ideally, experience working in an e-commerce business



HOW TO APPLY:

1. Please put in the title “Video Editor July 2026: [Your first name]”

2. We welcome cover letters. You don’t have to but it’s your opportunity to be unique. In the letter tell us about your experience, what editing tools/apps you use, your AI video experience, and the resources you use to stay up-to-date with video editing.

3. You MUST provide examples of work or a portfolio

4. Provide your desired salary or hourly rate



Let’s change things.



Thanks and good luck.

title: Video Editor and Content Designer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I am a US based financial advisor building an educational personal brand for professionals going through big career and money transitions, especially people recently laid off from big tech. The content is calm, clear, and genuinely helpful. No hype, no hard selling.



This is a video first role. Most weeks the core job is turning my webinars and talks into short vertical clips for LinkedIn: find the 
nt, cut it tight, caption it, make it on brand. The second half is graphic design: LinkedIn carousels, single image cards, ebook and guide covers, and profile banners, built from my copy and brand kit in Canva or basic Photoshop or Illustrator. You will also repurpose one long asset into many, and schedule finished posts.



I already have the brand system, the templates, and the copy. I need a reliable producer to turn that into finished, on brand video and graphics, week after week. You are the hands that make it look sharp and ship on time. This starts part time (about 20 hours a week) and grows into a full time, long term role. I would rather keep one great person for years than churn through cheap help.



HARD REQUIREMENTS (PLEASE READ)



- You are based in the Philippines.

- You have reliable high speed internet. You will send a speed test screenshot.

- You can work US Central business hours, 9 to 5 CST (Austin, Texas). That is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so you must be comfortable working nights.



WHAT YOU NEED TO BE GOOD AT



- Video editing, first and most important. Short form vertical (9:16), tight cuts, clean captions readable on mute, simple motion, on brand intro and outro. This is the skill I hire on.

- Graphic design, second. Clean, on brand cards, carousels, ebook covers, and banners in Canva or basic Photoshop or Illustrator.

- Good written English. You will caption financial content, so spelling and accuracy matter.

- Organized and reliable. You hit deadlines and keep source files and exports tidy.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Motion graphics, Descript, or auto caption tools.

- Experience running a content calendar or a scheduler like Buffer.

- LinkedIn content experience.



You do NOT need a finance background. This is a production role. I will teach you the subject and the rules.



HOW WE WORK



- This is regulated financial content. Nothing goes live without my written approval. You produce and schedule, I review and approve, then it ships. You never publish on your own.

- Long term relationship. Part time to start, growing to full time on performance.



HOW TO APPLY



This role is for applicants based in the Philippines only, with reliable high speed internet, who can work 9 to 5 CST.



I hire on the work you show me, not on a resume, so the application includes a short real task using my own footage. It takes about an hour.

title: Virtual Assistant for Growing Online Coaching Company
description:
HALENESS COACHING  ·  OPEN ROLE



Virtual Assistant — Operations & Marketing

Remote — Philippines   |   Part-to-Full Time   |   Health & Wellness Coaching



Please read this posting in full before applying. Applications that do not follow the instructions below will not be reviewed. We are hiring for quality, not quantity.



ABOUT THE COMPANY



Who We Are

Haleness Coaching is an online health and wellness coaching company serving healthcare professional mothers. We help high-achieving women in medicine and healthcare reclaim their metabolic health, hormones, and energy — without sacrificing their careers or their families.



Our founder is a practicing Physician Assistant who has built a systems-based coaching methodology rooted in functional health, nutrition, and hormone optimization. We use Go High Level as our central platform for everything from funnels and pipelines to client communication and automation.



We move fast, we care about precision, and we hold a high standard for the quality of work we put out into the world. We are looking for someone who genuinely matches that.



THE POSITION

What This Role Is



This is not an entry-level assistant role. We need someone who can come in, orient quickly, and execute — independently and with precision. You will own critical operational and marketing functions that directly affect client experience and business growth.



You will work directly with the founder. That means you will see how the business runs, and you will have a real impact on it. The right person will grow significantly in this role over time.



Build and maintain funnels, landing pages, VSLs, and pipelines in Go High Level

Set up and manage automations, workflows, and CRM pipelines in GHL

Use AI tools (including Manus and Claude) daily to complete tasks faster and at a higher quality standard

Create and schedule social media content; manage posting and basic engagement

Design client-facing documents, graphics, and branded assets in Canva

Support lead follow-up and setter activity (if experienced — highly valued)

Organize and maintain the founder's administrative and operational systems

Attend weekly virtual tea
etings and provide status updates proactively

Identify inefficiencies and suggest solutions without being asked





WHAT WE REQUIRE

Qualifications

Marked REQUIRED are non-negotiable. If you do not meet these, please do not apply.



REQUIRED  

Go High Level — Advanced

You must have significant hands-on experience building in GHL. This includes funnels, VSLs, landing pages, pipelines, workflows, and automations. You should be able to build and troubleshoot these independently.



REQUIRED  

AI Tools — Practical Daily Use

You must actively use AI to work faster and produce higher-quality output. This is not optional. We expect you to use AI to draft, research, edit, and problem-solve — not as a novelty, but as a core part of how you work.



REQUIRED  

Prior VA Experience

You must have worked as a VA before — ideally in a health, coaching, or wellness context. You must be able to provide at least one professional reference from a previous role.



REQUIRED  

Self-Direction

You do not need to be managed on a task-by-task basis. You take initiative, follow through, and communicate proactively when something is done, stuck, or needs clarity.



REQUIRED  

Reliability & Organization

Meetings are attended. Deadlines are met. Nothing falls through the cracks. You track your own work and hold yourself accountable without being reminded.



REQUIRED  

English Proficiency

You can communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English. This is essential for client-facing materials and team communication.



REQUIRED  

Daily Internet & Tech Access

You must have reliable daily access to the internet and a functioning device capable of running GHL, Canva, and video calls without issue.





PREFERRED  

Setting Experience

Experience in an appointment-setting or lead engagement role is a significant advantage. If you have this background, make it visible in your application.



PREFERRED  

Health Coach / Wellness Industry Background

Experience supporting a health coach, nutritionist, or wellness brand gives you immediate context. This is not required but will move you to the top of the list.



PREFERRED  

Canva Proficiency

Experience creating on-brand graphics, carousel posts, and client-facing documents in Canva at a professional level.



PREFERRED  

Social Media Content Management

Experience planning, scheduling, and managing content — particularly for Instagram — with an understanding of engagement best practices.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…



You have little to no experience using Go High Level in a real business context

You are not actively using AI tools in your daily work and cannot demonstrate experience with Manus or Claude 

You are unable to provide a professional reference from a previous VA role

You need constant direction, check-ins, or step-by-step instruction to complete tasks

You treat this as a side job and are not available or responsive during agreed-upon hours

You miss meetings without notice or let tasks slip without communicating

You are applying to multiple generic VA listings and this is not a deliberate choice



WHAT WE OFFER

What You Get



100% remote — work from anywhere 

Room to grow — expand your role and your pay as the business grows

Real exposure — work directly inside a growing online coaching business

Supportive team — a growth-minded, health-focused environment



HOW TO APPLY

Application Instructions



To be considered, your application must include all of the following. Incomplete applications will not move forward.



1.  A short video introduction (60–90 seconds)

2.  Proof of Go High Level experience

3.  Proof of AI tools experience

4.  A professional reference

5.  Answer this question in your application

title: Part-Time Content Editor (The Human Layer in an AI Workflow)
description:
Affilino is an SEO agency working with a portfolio of AU/NZ clients across e-commerce, legal, and other verticals. We draft a lot of content with AI, and we run automated humaniser scripts that strip the obvious AI tells (em dashes, 'in today's landscape,' rule of three, sycophancy, hedging, all that). So by the time content reaches you, it already reads cleanly on the surface.



That's the easy 80%. We're hiring you for the 20% no script can do.



What we actually need from you:



1. Judgment on truth. AI will write 'industry observers have noted' or 'a 2024 study found.' We need you to ask: is that real? Find the source or kill the claim.



2. Lived voice. AI writes like someone who has read about a topic. We need it to sound like someone who has done it. Anecdote, specificity, the small detail that proves the writer was actually in the room.



3. Editorial taste. Knowing what to cut. Knowing when a paragraph is technically fine but adds nothing. Knowing when the intro is buried in the third paragraph.



4. Brand voice memory. We run content for several clients, each with a different tone. A legal client is sober. An e-commerce client is warmer. You'll learn each voice and hold the line.



5. Catching second-pass AI residue. After a humanizer pass, what remains? Often: confident-sounding sentences that don't actually say anything. Generalities dressed as insight. You will hunt these.



What you will NOT do:



- Run our content through ChatGPT or another humanizer and send it back. We already have that.

- Surface-level proofreading. Grammarly handles that.

- Generic 'make it more engaging' rewrites.



Who you are:



- Native-level written English

- 2+ years editing experience (publication, agency, in-house, or strong freelance portfolio)

- You read a lot. Books, longform journalism, Substacks. You have opinions about writing.

- You can tell us, in plain words, what makes a sentence dead

- You meet deadlines

- Comfortable in Google Docs



Bonus:

- SEO awareness (H-structure, internal links, search intent)

- Background reading or editing in legal, e-commerce, insurance, or finance

- You've worked with AI content workflows before and have war stories



How to apply:



Skip the cover letter. Send us:



1. One paragraph on a piece of AI-generated content that fooled you or your client recently. What was the giveaway when you looked closer? If you've never been fooled, tell us what you watch for.



2. 1-2 work samples (before/after if possible).



3. Your monthly rate in USD.



4. Include the word 'mango' in your reply.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid 500-word test edit on real content. The piece will have already been through an automated humanizer pass, so the test is whether you can find what the machine missed.



Looking forward to reading your work.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
About Us

North Vault is a service that provides
 advertising infrastructure to media buyers and agencies. We supply things like Business Managers, ad accounts, profiles, and Pages to clients who need reliable setups for their advertising operations. All of our client communication happens through 
, and we track everything internally and deliver through our dashboard. We're growing steadily and we need an extra pair of hands to help us keep up with client requests and day-to-day support.



The Role

We're not looking for a
 expert here. What we need is someone who is fast, reliable, and genuinely dedicated to keeping clients happy. Most of what you'll be doing is straightforward — responding to client messages in our 
 server, helping them with basic questions, passing along deliveries, and making sure everything gets logged properly in our system. The work itself isn't complicated, but it does require you to be on top of things. When a client reaches out, they need a response quickly, not hours later. That's the single most important thing in this role: fast reaction times and consistent availability.

You'll be trained on how our processes work and what our products are, so you don't need to come in already knowing the ins and outs of

If you're someone who checks in regularly, responds promptly, and takes pride in doing even simple tasks well, you're exactly who we're looking for.

This is a daily role that requires your attention seven days a week. On most days the workload will be somewhere between two and four hours, though some days will be lighter depending on how busy things are. It's not a traditional nine-to-five job, but it does require you to be consistently present and responsive throughout the day. Clients don't stop reaching out on weekends, so neither can we.



What We're Looking For

???? PAY

We are looking for a creative, highly skilled, and reliable video editor who wants to help build a world-class podcast brand.



This is much more than simply cutting footage together.



We are looking for someone who understands storytelling, viewer psychology, pacing, emotion, and how to keep audiences watching until the very end.



You should understand that every second matters.



Every cut.

Every zoom.

Every sound effect.

Every pause.

Every caption.



...should have a purpose.



Our goal is to create some of the highest-quality podcast content on YouTube and social media.

One of our biggest inspirations is Diary of a CEO.



Before applying, please watch at least three full episodes and study the editing.



Pay close attention to:



• Opening hooks

• Curiosity gaps

• Open loops

• Emotional storytelling

• Cinematic pacing

• Strategic zooms

• Music placement

• Sound design

• Tension and release

• Retention psychology



We're not looking to copy their style.



We're looking for someone who understands WHY viewers stay engaged.



If you understand the psychology behind great editing, you'll fit in well with our team.





ABOUT OUR BRAND



You will be editing content for Christy Love.



Christy's brand is unlike anyone else's.



She is an:



• Adult entertainer

• Ordained pastor

• Stand-up comedian

• Author

Her podcast, In Bed with Christy Love, features comedians, actors, entrepreneurs, influencers, adult industry personalities, athletes, and guests with extraordinary life stories.

• Comedy

• Relationships

• Mental health

• Personal growth

• Redemption

• Human psychology



The goal is to make people laugh...



Think...



Feel...



And walk away seeing the world differently.





CURRENT REACH



• 250,000+ followers across social media

• Approximately 8 million monthly views



We are investing heavily into growing this brand over the next several years.



We're looking for people who want to grow with us.





WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Each week you'll edit approximately:



• 2–3 podcast episodes



Each episode is generally between 1 and 2 hours long.





DELIVERABLES PER PROJECT



Each completed project includes:



• One professionally edited podcast video

• One professionally mastered podcast audio file

• One full podcast video with captions

• Five high-performing vertical videos

• Exported files ready for publishing

• Organized project files (if requested)





RESPONSIBILITIES



You'll be responsible for:



• Editing long-form podcast episodes

• Synchronizing multiple camera angles

• Removing mistakes, interruptions, filler words, and unnecessary dead space

• Improving pacing and overall viewer retention

• Creating compelling opening hooks

• Building curiosity throughout the episode

• Enhancing audio quality

• Balancing audio levels

• Adding intro, commercial, and outro sequences

• Creating engaging captions

• Delivering five viral-ready short-form clips

• Meeting weekly deadlines consistently





VISUAL EDITING REQUIREMENTS

You should be comfortable with:



• Multi-camera editing

• Color correction

• Color grading

• White balance adjustments

• Exposure correction

• Brightness and contrast adjustments

• Skin tone correction

• Image sharpening

• Creating a polished cinematic look





AUDIO EDITING REQUIREMENTS



Audio quality is extremely important.



You should know how to:



• Reduce background noise

• Clean dialogue

• Balance audio levels

• Remove distracting pauses

• Improve clarity

• Deliver professional-quality podcast audio





RETENTION PSYCHOLOGY



This is one of the most important parts of this position.



We aren't looking for someone who simply edits.



We're looking for someone who understands why people continue watching.



You should understand concepts like:

• Curiosity loops

• Pattern interrupts

• Open loops

• Emotional storytelling

• Building tension

• Releasing tension

• Watch-time optimization

CREATING VIRAL CLIPS

nts

nts

nts

LIPS

title: Legal Assistant (Remote)
description:
Shift: Coverage window: Friday 3:00 PM – Monday 9:00 AM Philippine Time — this is when our regular Philippines-based team is off for the weekend, but our US attorneys are still working and will need active, responsive support during this window



Work Schedule: 32 hours per week — 8-hour shifts within the Friday 3:00 PM – Monday 9:00 AM Philippine Time window, plus one floating 8-hour day scheduled elsewhere in the week; exact daily start times to be arranged



About Unified CLO

Unified CLO is not a traditional law firm.

We serve as an extension of our clients' legal departments, providing experienced General Counsel, Associate General Counsel, attorneys, paralegals, and legal operations professionals who work together as one team.

Because we work remotely and collaborate across multiple time zones, our success depends on people who communicate well, take ownership of their responsibilities, and help keep the entire team moving forward.

We're looking for a Legal Assistant who is genuinely excited about using AI and AI agents to work smarter, enjoys creating order, and takes pride in producing polished, beautifully formatted work. This is more than an administrative role — you'll help define how our team uses AI to operate every day.

This particular role exists to cover the gap after our regular Philippines-based team wraps up for the week — you'll be the one keeping things moving over the weekend. Our US attorneys are still actively working during this window, so you'll need to be responsive and ready to jump in, not just monitoring quietly in the background.



What You'll Do

You'll be a key member of our Operations, especially our Client Success Teams, supporting attorneys while helping ensure client matters move efficiently from start to finish.

Your responsibilities will include:

? Use AI and AI agents as a core part of your daily workflow — drafting, formatting, proofreading, summarizing, and finding ways to make our processes faster and more consistent.

? Prepare, format, proofread, and finalize contracts, legal documents, presentations, and client communications, using AI tools to speed up production without sacrificing polish or accuracy.

? Create polished, professional documents using advanced Microsoft Word and Google Workspace features, including styles, templates, tables, headers, footers, letterhead, automatic tables of contents, and consistent formatting.

? Maintain Google Sheets used to track legal matters, contracts, projects, deadlines, and internal operations.

? Serve as the primary administrator for our Adobe Sign and DocuSign workflows, including preparing signature packets, tracking execution status, and maintaining executed agreements.

? Organize and maintain our electronic filing systems so documents are easy to locate, consistently organized, and up to date.

? Help manage attorney workflows by tracking assignments, monitoring deadlines, and following up on outstanding tasks.

? Coordinate with attorneys to make sure projects continue moving forward and nothing falls through the cracks.

? Help prioritize incoming work requests and communicate updates to the appropriate tea
mbers.

? Identify bottlenecks, unanswered questions, or overdue items before they become problems.

? Contribute to legal design by creating documents that are clean, organized, visually professional, and easy for clients to read.

? Continuously look for opportunities to apply AI and automation to our workflows, and share what you learn with the team.

? Assist with other legal operations and administrative projects as our company continues to grow.



What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious about AI, takes ownership without being asked twice, and has an eye for detail and design.

You don't wait to be reminded. You enjoy organizing information, keeping projects moving, and making life easier for the people around you. You're comfortable working independently — we shouldn't have to micromanage you — while knowing when to ask questions or raise concerns.

The right person will:

? Be genuinely enthusiastic about using AI tools and AI agents to work smarter, and enjoy experimenting with new ways to apply them to real workflows.

? Stay responsive to attorneys who are actively working and may have urgent, time-sensitive requests — our US attorneys don't stop working over the weekend, so this isn't a quiet monitoring shift.

? Be exceptionally organized and detail-oriented — the kind of person who catches the small thing everyone else missed.

? Work independently and take full ownership of your responsibilities.

? Enjoy managing multiple projects and changing priorities.

? Be comfortable following up with attorneys to keep matters moving and deadlines on track.

? Communicate professionally and confidently with attorneys, clients, and teammates.

? Take pride in producing polished, beautifully formatted work, and understand that well-designed documents are easier to read and inspire confidence.

? Be dependable, responsive, and accountable.

? Work well in a collaborative remote environment.

? Be available to work 8-hour shifts within the Friday 3:00 PM – Monday 9:00 AM Philippine Time window, plus one floating 8-hour day during the week — 32 hours total; this coverage window is important to us.



Required Qualifications

? Real, hands-on experience using AI tools and/or AI agents (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, custom automations, or similar) to get actual work done — not just casual or occasional use.

? Excellent Microsoft Word and Google Workspace skills, including advanced document formatting.

? Strong project management skills, including a track record of coordinating workflows, managing timelines, and driving initiatives from inception to completion with minimal oversight.

? Exceptional attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills.

? Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

? Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.

? Ability to work 8-hour shifts within the Friday 3:00 PM – Monday 9:00 AM Philippine Time window, plus one floating 8-hour day elsewhere in the week (32 hours/week total).



Nice to Have

? Prior experience in a law firm, corporate legal department, or the legal services industry — helpful, but not required. We care far more about your AI fluency, organizational skills, and attention to detail than your specific industry background.

? Experience with Adobe Sign, DocuSign, or similar electronic signature platforms.

? Experience organizing and maintaining electronic filing systems.



If you've built exceptional organizational skills, AI fluency, and project management chops in another professional environment, we'd still love to hear from you.

s, route information to the correct client profiles, and ensure tasks are executed so nothing falls through the cracks.

eting (typically between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM US Central Time) to align on the day's priorities.

title: Product Lister (Remote)
description:
## Short version



We use AI to build our product pages. AI writes the titles, descriptions, product types, metafields and GTINs, and pulls in the imagery. What AI cannot do is judge whether the page will actually make a German customer click "In den Warenkorb."



That's your job.



You are the human quality layer between an AI-generated draft and a live product page. Nothing goes live until you've checked it, corrected it, and made it good enough to sell.



---



## About us



We run several Shopify stores selling to Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with additional markets in the EU. We're a small remote team of specialists — media buying, supply chain, product listing, automation — and we ship fast. No layers of management, no waiting three weeks for approval on a headline change.



We've automated the boring 80% of listing work. We're hiring for the 20% that d
 whether we make money.



---



## What you'll actually do



Every day you get a queue of new AI-generated product pages. You go through them one by one and make them ready to go live.



**Check and correct the AI output**



- Title, description and bullets: is it accurate, clear, and does it actually sell the product?

- Fix what's weak: generic copy, unclear benefits, wrong tone, claims we can't support

- Make sure the page answers the obvious questions a buyer would have



**Get the settings right**



- Variants: naming, ordering, option logic, correct image per variant

- Product type, metafields, GTIN, tags, collections

- Anything wrong here breaks our ads feed, so this part has to be exact



**Build the image set**



- Choose and order the photos: hero image, benefit shots, size/scale reference, in-use, detail

- Remove weak or duplicate images, crop and clean up where needed



**Set up the offer**



- Price points, compare-at price, bundles or quantity breaks, shipping messaging



You'll be working to a clear standard we'll teach you, and your work gets reviewed and discussed — especially in the first months.



---



## What we're looking for



**We will train you.** You do not need e-commerce experience, marketing knowledge, or a portfolio. We have the systems, the frameworks and the process — what we cannot install in someone is the way they think. That's what we're screening for.



**Must have**



- **Real hunger to learn.** Not "I'm a fast learner" on a CV — actual evidence that you go and figure things out on your own. The people who do best here are the ones who watch the training twice, take notes, and come back with questions.

- **You're sharp.** You can hold a problem in your head, form a theory about it, and explain your thinking clearly. We'd rather have someone smart who knows nothing than someone experienced who stopped thinking.

- **You're professional.** You reply when you say you will, you flag problems early instead of hiding them, you meet deadlines, and your work is clean. This matters more to us than raw talent.

- **Buyer instinct.** You can look at a product page and say what would stop *you* from paying for it.

- **Obsessive attention to detail.** A wrong GTIN, a variant with the wrong image, a broken metafield — these cost us real money. Sloppy work is the one thing we can't train away.

- **You take feedback well.** Early on, a lot of your work will come back marked up. People who treat that as fuel do very well here. People who take it personally don't last.

- **Strong written and spoken English**, and clear async communication

- **Self-management.** We give you a queue and a target, not someone watching your screen

- Reliable internet, a workspace where you can concentrate, and some overlap with CET hours



**Helps, but not required**



- Any experience with Shopify, product listings, e-commerce VA work, or online selling of any kind

- Comfort with AI tools — you'll work with AI output all day, so you should see it as a starting point, not a finished answer

- Basic image editing (cropping, cleanup, simple graphic overlays)



**Not required at all**



- A degree

- Coding

- Marketing background



---



What we offer



- Fully remote, permanent, long-term role — we hire people to stay

- Salary range: $3-5/ hour

- **Paid, structured training.** You'll be taught our listing standard step by step, with feedback on your work from day one. You are not expected to know this on arrival.

- Direct impact: your pages go live the same day and start selling

- A team that has already automated the repetitive work, so your time goes into judgement

- **A real growth path.** Product listing is where you start. People who do this well get trained in conversion optimisation — improving pages that already run ads — which is the more senior and better-paid side of this work.



---



How to apply



Two parts. Both are required — applications missing either one aren't reviewed.



1. Your CV and four questions



Send your CV — no cover letter needed. Instead, answer these in your message. Short answers are fine; we care about the thinking, not the length.



1. **What's something you taught yourself recently, and how did you go about it?**

2. **Think of the last thing you bought online for yourself that cost more than €30.** What almost stopped you from buying it? Be specific — what were you unsure about, and what convinced you in the end?

3. **Now think of something you looked at online and d
 *not* to buy.** What was missing?

4. **Your situation:** availability, how many hours per week you can commit, and your internet setup.



There is no "right" answer to questions 2 and 3 — we want to hear how you think as a buyer. Someone who says "I wasn't sure it would fit, and the size chart didn't help" tells us far more than someone who writes a paragraph about conversion optimisation. Please write your own answers; anything obviously written by AI goes straight to the no pile.



2. A short video



**Record a Loom of maximum 2 minutes** and include the link. Loom is free at 
 and works straight from your browser — no software to install. Camera on, no editing, no script. One take is fine.



Tell us:



- Who you are, in a few sentences

- **Question 2 above, but out loud** — the last thing you bought online and what almost stopped you

- Why this job, and what you'd want to get out of it



We're not judging your accent, your background, or your camera. We want to hear how you explain something in your own words. A relaxed, honest 90 seconds beats a polished, rehearsed 2 minutes every time.



---



Everyone who sends both parts gets a reply. Shortlisted candidates get a short practical assignment on a real product page in the next round.

title: K-12 Virtual Tutors
description:
About Spark Xplorer



Spark Xplorer is a K–12 tutoring program supporting U.S.-based scholars with personalized, one-on-one and small-group learning. We currently have an established team of tutors, and we're now growing our global tutor network by recruiting a small, high-quality cohort of tutors based in the Philippines. This is a chance to get in early on a program that rewards strong performance with more hours as it scales.



About the Role



We're looking for qualified, reliable, and engaging online tutors to teach U.S. K–12 scholars in Math, English Language Arts (ELA), and/or Science. You'll work alongside our existing tutor team as part of one Spark Xplorer Global Tutor Network, delivering sessions aligned to each scholar's personalized learning plan.



We're hiring across a few different profiles — you don't need to fit all of them:





K–5 Elementary — Math and ELA

Grades 6–8 — Math and/or ELA

Grades 6–12 — Math

Grades 6–12 — Science or another high-demand specialist subject





Tutors who can competently teach multiple subjects or grade levels are especially valued.



What You'll Do



Deliver online tutoring sessions to U.S. K–12 scholars following Spark Xplorer's personalized curriculum and weekly learning plans

Explain concepts clearly, adapt your teaching style to each student, and keep sessions engaging

Track and report on session progress using Spark Xplorer's systems and approved tools

Maintain professional, appropriate communication with minors and their parents at all times

Complete required training, assessments, and ongoing performance check-ins





What We're Looking For





Strong spoken and written English, with clear and easily understandable communication

Experience teaching or tutoring K–12 students (online tutoring experience is a plus)

Comfort with U.S.-based students; familiarity with U.S. curriculum/Common Core is an advantage but not required — strong subject knowledge and teaching ability matter most, and we provide training

Experience working with children, and genuine enjoyment of teaching them

Reliable internet connection, a functional computer with working camera/microphone, and a quiet, professional teaching space

Backup internet and backup power arrangements (recommended, given regional outages)

Availability during U.S. teaching hours

Comfortable using video conferencing, screen sharing, digital whiteboards, Google Docs, and online learning platforms





Prior experience with Zoom-based tutoring, ESL instruction, or Math/Science tutoring is a plus.



Compensation & Engagement





Pay: Approximately $5–$7 per teaching hour, based on subject certification and experience

Tutors join our available tutor pool; hours are not fixed initially and grow based on scholar demand, availability, and performance

A 60-day initial review period applies to new tutors, starting with a limited caseload

High-performing tutors receive priority for additional sessions and hours as demand grows





Application Process



This is a multi-stage process to ensure a strong fit for our scholars:





Application form — background, education, experience, availability, and expected rate

Document submission — CV/resume, government-issued ID, relevant certificates, a short introductory video, an internet speed test, and professional references

Initial screening — HR review of qualifications, communication, and overall fit

Assessments — spoken English & instructional communication, subject knowledge test, and a short teaching audition

Vetting — identity verification, education/employment verification, reference checks, and a criminal background check (required, as this role involves working directly with minors)

Training & certification — completion of Spark Xplorer's tutor training program and final assessment





Only candidates who successfully complete all vetting and certification steps will be onboarded as Spark Xplorer Certified Tutors.



What to Submit



To apply, please prepare:





Your CV/resume

Education and teaching certificates (if applicable)

A short (2–3 minute) introductory video covering: who you are, subjects/grade levels you can teach, your teaching experience, why you enjoy teaching children, and why you're interested in Spark Xplorer

An internet speed test result

Contact details for at least two professional references







Spark Xplorer is committed to child safety. All tutors are required to complete identity verification, background screening, and child safeguarding training before being assigned to scholars.

title: Senior Bookkeeper / Accounting Specialist
description:
This reads much more like a real founder wrote it than an HR department. It also sets expectations clearly and attracts people looking for a long-term opportunity.



---



We're looking for an experienced Bookkeeper / Accounting Specialist to help us get our company's finances fully organized.



The **initial project** will be cleaning up several months of bookkeeping, organizing our financial records, reconciling bank accounts and payment processors, and building a solid accounting system that we can rely on moving forward. Right now our books need a complete cleanup, and we're looking for someone who enjoys taking disorganized finances and turning them into accurate, well-organized records.



This is more than just entering transactions. We want someone who can identify problems, recommend improvements, build better systems, and help create the accounting processes our company will use as we continue to grow.



You should have strong experience with QuickBooks Online, account reconciliations, bookkeeping, and working with U.S.-based businesses. Experience with Stripe, payroll, and service businesses is a plus.



We're looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, communicates well in English, and can work independently without needing constant supervision. Accuracy is extremely important because you'll be working directly with the owner to organize the financial side of the business.



This position will begin as a **part-time contract project** focused on cleaning up our books. If you do an excellent job, communicate well, and prove to be a good long-term fit, our goal is to offer you a **full-time position** with the company at **40 hours per week**, starting at **$8 USD per hour or more**, depending on your experience and performance. We are looking for someone we can continue working with for years, not just someone to complete a one-time project.



**Please read carefully before applying.**



We receive a large number of applications, so we only review applicants who follow instructions.



To be considered, you **must** upload a **1-2 minute video introduction** with your application. Applications submitted without a video will not be considered.



In your video, please answer the following:



* Tell us your name and where you're from.

* Tell us about your bookkeeping and accounting experience.

* Describe a bookkeeping cleanup project you've completed.

* Why do you believe you're the best fit for this position?

* What accounting software are you most experienced with?

* When are you available to start?



The video does **not** need to be professionally made. We simply want to meet the person we'll potentially be working with and see how you communicate.



Finally, to show that you've actually read this entire posting, **start the first line of your application with the words "Financial Systems Builder."** Applications that do not include this phrase will not be reviewed.



We value people who take pride in their work, think critically, communicate proactively, and genuinely enjoy building organized systems. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience handling franchise tax filings for multiple states.

Strong understanding of GAAP-based bookkeeping principles.

title: Video Editor and Content Designer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I am a US based financial advisor building an educational personal brand for professionals going through big career and money transitions, especially people recently laid off from big tech. The content is calm, clear, and genuinely helpful. No hype, no hard selling.



This is a video first role. Most weeks the core job is turning my webinars and talks into short vertical clips for LinkedIn: find the 
nt, cut it tight, caption it, make it on brand. The second half is graphic design: LinkedIn carousels, single image cards, ebook and guide covers, and profile banners, built from my copy and brand kit in Canva or basic Photoshop or Illustrator. You will also repurpose one long asset into many, and schedule finished posts.



I already have the brand system, the templates, and the copy. I need a reliable producer to turn that into finished, on brand video and graphics, week after week. You are the hands that make it look sharp and ship on time. This starts part time (about 20 hours a week) and grows into a full time, long term role. I would rather keep one great person for years than churn through cheap help.



HARD REQUIREMENTS (PLEASE READ)



- You are based in the Philippines.

- You have reliable high speed internet. You will send a speed test screenshot.

- You can work US Central business hours, 9 to 5 CST (Austin, Texas). That is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so you must be comfortable working nights.



WHAT YOU NEED TO BE GOOD AT



- Video editing, first and most important. Short form vertical (9:16), tight cuts, clean captions readable on mute, simple motion, on brand intro and outro. This is the skill I hire on.

- Graphic design, second. Clean, on brand cards, carousels, ebook covers, and banners in Canva or basic Photoshop or Illustrator.

- Good written English. You will caption financial content, so spelling and accuracy matter.

- Organized and reliable. You hit deadlines and keep source files and exports tidy.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Motion graphics, Descript, or auto caption tools.

- Experience running a content calendar or a scheduler like Buffer.

- LinkedIn content experience.



You do NOT need a finance background. This is a production role. I will teach you the subject and the rules.



HOW WE WORK



- This is regulated financial content. Nothing goes live without my written approval. You produce and schedule, I review and approve, then it ships. You never publish on your own.

- Long term relationship. Part time to start, growing to full time on performance.



HOW TO APPLY



Because I hire on the work you show me, not a resume, the application is a short form with a real task (about an hour). Start your reply here with the word CLARITY so I know you read this, then complete the form: 




. 



I read every complete one.

title: Guest Communications Specialist
description:
ABOUT US

Exhale Vacation Rentals is a boutique short-term rental property management company based in Palm Beach County, South Florida. We manage a curated portfolio of luxury properties and take pride in delivering a white-glove guest experience on every stay. We are a small, owner-operated team — every person on our team plays a meaningful role in how we show up for our guests and our owners.

We are growing, and we are looking for someone who takes pride in their work — not because someone is watching, but because that's just who they are.



THE ROLE

This is an evening shift position (approximately 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM ET or as agreed), Wednesday to Sunday. You will be the primary point of contact for our guests during your shift, while also owning a set of ongoing operational and listing optimization responsibilities that keep our business running smoothly.



This is not a pure guest communications role. The majority of your shift, especially during quieter periods, will be spent on business operations tasks — listing optimization, TouchStay guide management, purchasing inbox management, and review reporting. Guest communications will come in throughout your shift but will not consume most of it.

If you are looking for a job where you can clock in, answer a few messages, and coast — this is not the role for you. If you are someone who is self-directed, detail-obsessed, and genuinely enjoys finding better ways to do things, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Purchasing inbox management — own this inbox end to end from the 
nt your shift begins. Organize, action, follow up, and keep it orderly every single day.



Guest communications — respond to Airbnb reviews, handle inbound guest inquiries, respond to CanMonkey
s, assign restocks using the Cost Feature, and set up property issue alerts. All outbound communication must happen in the first half of your shift and no later than 8:00 PM.



Listing optimization — monthly refresh of all active listings across Airbnb, Vrbo, and 
. This includes strategic photo reordering, description rewrites, RankBreeze analysis, and a full quarterly accuracy audit covering bedroom counts, rate plans, and amenity accuracy.



TouchStay digital guide — take full ownership of our guest guides across all properties. Keep restaurant recommendations, property instructions, and all content current and accurate.



Review management — respond to all Airbnb reviews in a timely and on-brand manner, proactively ask guests for Google reviews, and compile a quarterly review report per property for distribution to homeowners using Canva.

Deliveries and purchasing tracking — monitor incoming orders, track deliveries, record purchases in the tracker, and alert the team immediately when items are cancelled so alternatives can be sourced.



CanMonkey and consumables coordination — order consumable items as needed per Breezeway and ensure all properties are stocked appropriately; monitor door lock batteries weekly.



Social media content hub — organize and maintain the content hub so photo and video assets are easy to locate and use for campaigns.



Audit and compliance tasks — conduct monthly audits of door access codes and quarterly audits of listings for accuracy. Flag any discrepancies immediately.



Property issue monitoring — follow and action property issue alerts as they arise, keeping management informed and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks between shifts.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

You will thrive in this role if you are:

Genuinely self-directed. You do not wait to be told what to do next. When you finish a task, you already know what comes next and you move there without prompting.



Detail-oriented in a real way. Not "I am detail-oriented" on a resume — but the kind of person who notices that a listing description says "walkable neighborhood" and actually Googles it to verify before leaving it in.



A clear, professional communicator. Your written guest communications are warm, grammatically clean, and appropriately concise. You do not send form-letter sounding responses. Guests feel like they are being helped by a real person who cares.

Accountable. When something does not get done, you own it and fix it — you do not explain it away. When you say you will do something, you do it.



Calm and sound under pressure. Vacation rental operations move fast. Things go wrong. Guests get frustrated. You stay grounded and solution-focused.





QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

Minimum 2 years of experience in vacation rental management, hospitality, property management, or a closely related field

Strong written English — your guest communications will represent our brand

Proficiency with Airbnb, Vrbo, or 
 listing management

Experience with or ability to quickly learn: Breezeway, OwnerRez, Slack, Asana, Google Workspace

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT etc.) as a starting point — but capable of applying your own judgment and editing to produce output that does not read as generic

Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, distraction-free work setup

Available for a consistent evening shift starting at 4:00 PM EST Wednesday to Sunday, and is open to shift changes as needed for coverage.



Preferred:

Experience with Breezeway, OwnerRez, Slack, Asana, Google Workspace

Canva experience (for quarterly review reports)

Familiarity with short-term rental SEO and listing optimization best practices

Experience working with a remote team across multiple time zones



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

We want to be transparent so the right person applies:

This is not a role where guest communications will fill your shift. Evening shifts in vacation rental are often quiet. You are expected to use that time productively on the operational tasks described above.

This is not a role where you can delegate or subcontract your work. Every task you complete must be done by you. The quality and tone of your output needs to be consistent and genuinely yours.

This is not a role for someone who needs to be managed closely. We are a lean team. We cannot spend time checking whether tasks were done, following up on things you confirmed, or untangling confusion that results from not reading instructions carefully.



COMPENSATION & DETAILS

Remote, full-time position

Evening shift: 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST (Wednesday to Sunday, but might change)

Competitive hourly rate based on experience

Contractor engagement

PTOs after 6 months of engagement

A paid birthday leave and bonus

Additional compensation for select holidays

Weekly pay out (every Friday)



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply with:

Your resume or CV

A 2-minute video introduction — skip the resume walkthrough, we can read. Tell us who you are, how you think, and why this role fits where you are right now

If you have experience with listing optimization, share one specific example of a change you made to a listing and why you made it

description:

Your Main Responsibilities:

1. Utility Invoice Processing

Receive utility invoices and ensure the utility folder is resolved to zero open items by end of day.

Enter utility invoices per property under the correct name.

Input utilities into the property management software (e.g., AppFolio) using proper GL accounts and property codes.

Maintain passwords/logins for utility accounts

Immediately notify Accounting Supervisor & Treasury Supervisor of any invoice or billing errors.

Provide a daily End-of-Day report to Accounting Supervisor & Treasury Supervisor documenting utility bills entered.

Communicate with the Accounting & Treasury Supervisors when a new utility vendor must be created to process invoices.

Document each onboarding step on the Onboarding Checklist with supporting documentation 
 confirmation, phone confirmation, contract copies).

Store utility transition confirmations for the property being onboarded.

Escalate any onboarding barriers (missing information, deposits required, ownership paperwork missing) to the Accounting & Treasury Supervisor immediately.

As jurisdictions, utility provider practices, lease terms, and internal processes evolve, adapt to changing workflows and procedures.

Remain responsive to new property acquisitions, portfolio growth or other changes.

What We’re Looking For:

At least 2 years of experience in utility billing, invoice processing, or property-management accounting highly desirable.

Strong sense of ownership and proactive communication — someone who will immediately report any problem or barrier (e.g., utility account issues, vendor set-up delays, login access problems) to the appropriate supervisor.

Prior experience using AppFolio or similar property management accounting software is advantageous.

Technical Skills:

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and ability to learn new systems quickly.

Experience managing passwords/logins securely using tools like Keeper Security or similar.

Familiarity with electronic billing and autopay setup processes.

Attention to Detail & Process-Oriented: Proven track record of accurate data entry, following checklists, meeting deadlines (e.g., zero open items by EOD).

Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to coordinate with internal teams and external utility providers.

Problem Solving: Ability to identify anomalies, escalate appropriately and follow through to resolution.

Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple properties/portfolios, daily tasks, reporting requirements and onboarding workflows concurrently.

Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where policies and programs may change.

Confidentiality & Integrity: Handle login credentials, financial information and vendor accounts securely and responsibly.



Nice to Haves:



Prior experience in a real-estate asset management company or multifamily/residential portfolio.

Experience in handling tenant billing and administrative fee processes.

Comfortable working under minimal supervision with defined workflows and checklists.

Initiative to improve processes, suggest efficiencies and maintain a clean inbox/folder system.

title: Freelance Technical SEO Specialist
description:
We're a UK-based digital marketing and web design agency looking for an experienced technical SEO freelancer to work with on an ad-hoc basis for complex troubleshooting that goes beyond standard on-page fixes.



We have a couple of live issues to start with, both more advanced technical SEO problems involving Google Search Console diagnostics, indexing behaviour, and crawl/canonical issues. We're not looking for general SEO audits or content recommendations, we need someone comfortable getting into the detail of crawl logs, GSC data, structured data, and server-level configuration to diagnose and fix issues that have resisted standard fixes.



Full details of the specific issues will be shared with shortlisted candidates, but to give a sense of the level of work involved, recent examples include things like:



• Diagnosing why Google is overriding declared canonical tags in favour of a country-specific sister domain, despite correct technical implementation (hreflang, structured data, locale signals all in place), likely requiring a content differentiation strategy alongside technical fixes

• Investigating unexplained large-scale URL/page detection in Search Console that doesn't match the actual site structure, likely caused by parameter handling or external link patterns



What we're looking for:

• Strong hands-on experience with GSC, log file analysis, URL parameter handling, canonicalisation, and international/hreflang SEO

• Comfortable working across WordPress/Divi and other CMS platforms

• You're comfortable working independently and digging into the detail until you find the actual cause, not just the obvious fix.

• Available for occasional projects rather than a fixed retainer, ideally someone we can build an ongoing relationship with for this kind of work as it comes up

• Great English skills.

• The ability to work to UK working hours

• Great internet connection and willingness to communicate via
, WhatsApp and Zoom (if required)



To apply:

Please share examples of similar technical SEO diagnostic work you've done, particularly anything involving canonical/indexing conflicts or crawl anomalies, and your typical approach to investigating an issue like this.



We're easy to work with and happy to share full context once we're talking, just want to make sure we're starting the conversation with the right people.

title: Virtual Assistant for UGC Creator – Content, Video & Social Media
description:
I’m a U.S.-based bilingual Japanese-English UGC creator looking for a reliable, organized, and trainable Virtual Assistant to support my growing content-creation business.



I create English- and Japanese-language content for brands in beauty, wellness, fitness, lifestyle, apps, and other consumer categories. Japanese-language ability is not required for this position.



This is a long-term, part-time position beginning at approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential to grow to 25–30 hours as your skills, responsibilities, and the business grow.



You do not need an impressive résumé or advanced editing skills. I care more about reliability, attention to detail, clear communication, willingness to learn, and the ability to follow instructions carefully.



I will provide training, examples, feedback, and written processes. When appropriate, I am also willing to provide access to courses that will help you develop the skills needed for the role.

CapCut

Instagram

TikTok

YouTube

Amazon Influencer

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:



+ Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

+ Follow instructions carefully

+ Ask questions when something is unclear

+ Are dependable and meet agreed deadlines

+ Have strong attention to detail

+ Keep tasks, files, and information organized

+ Are comfortable learning new software and processes

+ Can receive feedback and apply it to future work

+ Can work independently after receiving clear instructions

+ Take initiative once you understand a process

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

Opportunity to grow to 25–30 hours per week

Flexible working hours

Short Zoom check-in Monday through Friday

Check-ins will take place during my evening in U.S. Eastern Time and your morning in the Philippines

The strongest candidate will then be offered a one-week paid trial of up to 20 hours. The trial will be paid at the full starting rate of $3 USD per hour.

The paid trial will allow both of us to determine whether the work and communication style are a good long-term fit.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator (Creative Finance)
description:
Elk Ridge Investments is a growing real estate investment firm managing a multi-market portfolio of short-term rental properties. We are seeking an experienced Real Estate Transaction Coordinator with a strong background in Creative Finance transactions, particularly Subject-To, Seller Finance, Hybrid structures, and Wholesale deals.



This role is critical to ensuring transactions move smoothly from contract to close while maintaining organization, compliance, and clear communication between all parties involved.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, systems-driven, and experienced navigating complex real estate transactions, with the ability to coordinate between buyers, sellers, title companies, lenders, and internal tea
mbers. Strong communication and customer service skills are essential.



This is a full-time position within a fast-growing investment company, with opportunities to grow alongside the team.

Monday to Friday 

08:00 a.m. - 05:00 p.m. PST



What You’ll Do:

- Manage transactions from contract to closing, ensuring all required documentation is completed and submitted on time

- Coordinate with title companies, sellers, buyers, lenders, and internal tea
mbers to keep deals progressing

- Handle creative finance transaction workflows including Subject-To, Seller Finance, Hybrid, and Wholesale deals

- Track transaction timelines, contingencies, and closing requirements

- Maintain organized digital records of contracts, disclosures, and closing documents

- Assist with compliance and documentation requirements across multiple markets

- Ensure proper communication with all parties throughout the transaction process

- Identify and resolve issues that may delay closing

- We use PODIO and Slack



What We’re Looking For:

- Proven experience as a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator (investment or creative finance experience preferred)

- Strong understanding of Creative Finance strategies such as Subject-To, Seller Finance, Hybrid, and Wholesale deals

- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail

- Systems-oriented mindset with experience working with CRMs, transaction management tools, or compliance dashboards

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to manage multiple deals, deadlines, and markets simultaneously

- Proactive, self-directed, and solutions-focused approach

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced real estate investment environment



If you have experience coordinating real estate transactions—especially within creative finance—and thrive in an organized, fast-moving environment, we would love to connect.

title: SEO Copywriter
description:
SEO Copywriter (Freelance, Paid Per Article)

We are a small software company in the behavioral health space hiring a freelance SEO copywriter on a per-article basis. Ongoing volume for the right writer.

Every article includes



Keyword research and the search intent behind the piece

The article itself, roughly 800 to 1,500 words, written to rank and convert

Product screenshots captured and placed where they support the copy

Light graphic work: annotated screenshots, simple headers, visuals that follow our brand guide

One round of revisions

SEO writing samples with ranking or traffic results you can point to

Comfort writing for a professional audience in a regulated industry

Working knowledge of search intent, on-page SEO, and internal linking

Deadline reliability. Each piece is a self-contained deliverable.



Nice to have: healthcare, SaaS, or B2B software experience.

To apply: send two or three samples, your flat rate per article with everything above included, and your typical turnaround.

title: Video Editor – Localization & Adaptation
description:
We are looking for a fast, detail-oriented Video Localization Editor to join our team.



Your job will not be to create videos from scratch. Instead, you will take an existing Adobe Premiere Pro project (originally made in Slovenian) and adapt it into Czech, Hungarian, and German versions.



What you'll do

- Open our existing Premiere Pro project.

- Replace the Slovenian talking-head clips or voice-over clips with the provided clips in Czech, Hungarian, or German.

- Adapt the B-roll so it matches the new audio and the actions described in the translated script.

- Keep the pacing, style, and overall quality of the original video. 

- Export the final localized version.



We provide

- The complete Premiere Pro project.

- All translated scripts.

- All talking-head footage.

- All voice-overs.

- All necessary assets and instructions.



You do NOT need to know Slovenian, Czech, Hungarian, or German. Everything is prepared for you. Your job is to accurately follow the provided materials and make sure everything matches correctly.



What we're looking for

- Good Adobe Premiere Pro skills.

- Fast editing speed.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Someone who checks their own work before submitting.

- Someone who follows instructions precisely.

- A reliable editor who makes as few mistakes as possible.



Weekly KPI: 14 tasks per week (1 video = 3 language adaptations)



Accuracy is extremely important for this role. We are looking for someone who notices small details, uses common sense when something unexpected comes up, and delivers clean, mistake-free work.



Requirements

- Adobe Premiere Pro experience.

- A powerful PC or laptop capable of editing  and exporting smoothly

- Reliable internet connection.

- Good English communication skills.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person. We value reliability, consistency, and high-quality work, and we reward editors who consistently deliver excellent results. You can get bonuses if you provide more videos than the set KPI.



Think you're a good fit? We'd love to hear from you!



All applicants will complete a short editing test, and we're excited to see what you can do. Good luck, and we hope to work with you soon!

title: Homeowner Experience & Business Operations Coordinator
description:
What This Role Is About:



We’re looking for a Homeowner Experience & Business Operations Coordinator to play a key role in managing communication between homeowners and our internal teams. This position ensures smooth homeowner interactions, accurate CRM management, and operational efficiency across both the Homeowner Experience and Business Development departments. You’ll help maintain our reputation for professionalism, responsiveness, and care - while supporting internal teams with the data and reporting they need to grow the business.



Your Main Responsibilities:



Homeowner Communication (Primary Focus)



? Manage shared inboxes and CRM systems (HubSpot, Front, Mail Chimp, Beyond, Breezeway, Vintory), ensuring all inquiries are responded to promptly and routed correctly.



? Draft and distribute property owner updates, newsletters, and communications.



? Maintain accurate homeowner contact records and databases.



? Track and report on homeowner experience metrics, including response times and satisfaction scores.



? Prepare and format monthly homeowner communication summaries and reports.



Business Development Support 



? Support the BD team by tracking, qualifying, and organizing incoming leads.



? Keep CRM pipelines up-to-date with lead status and activity.



? Prepare weekly reports on lead conversion, pipeline health, and outreach performance.



? Assist in scheduling discovery calls, demos, and internal follow-up meetings.



? Coordinate cross-departmental handoffs between marketing and sales teams.



Administrative & Reporting



? Compile and distribute performance summaries for leadership (homeowner satisfaction, BD conversion rates, and operational efficiency).



? Ensure data accuracy across all systems and documentation



Mandatory Reporting Requirements



You will be responsible for compiling and reporting the following weekly and monthly metrics:



? homeowner and lead response times.



? Accuracy and completeness of CRM data.



? Satisfaction and feedback summaries from homeowners and homeowners.



? Efficiency metrics for BD support (reports delivered, meetings scheduled, data accuracy). 



What We’re Looking For:



Core Skills & Experience



? Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



? 2+ years in administrative, homeowner-facing, or CRM-based support roles.



? Strong attention to detail, multitasking, and organization.



? Empathetic, professional communication style suited to homeowners and internal stakeholders.



? Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely. Technical Proficiency



? Experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot, Vintory, or Front.



? Proficient in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office Suite.



? Strong reporting and data analysis capabilities (Sheets, Excel). 



 Preferred Qualifications



? Prior experience in the vacation rental or property management industry (Guesty).



? Familiarity with business development, marketing automation, or customer support tools.



? Understanding of homeowner communication best practices and satisfaction metrics.



Availability & Flexibility



? Standard Monday–Friday schedule with occasional flexibility for time zone coordination.



? Occasional meeting participation outside core hours may be required to align with global teams
