title: Full-Cycle Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
Position: Full-Cycle Accounts Payable Specialist



Salary: PHP 40,000 per month



Schedule: Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



• Minimum 3 years of hands-on, full-cycle accounts payable experience



• Experience supporting a U.S.-based company and working with U.S. accounting practices



• Experience independently managing AP from invoice receipt through approval, payment, reconciliation, and month-end close



• Strong knowledge of invoice review, GL coding, approval workflows, payment processing, vendor reconciliation, and AP aging



• Experience handling a high volume of invoices and multiple vendors, departments, or locations



• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills



• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills



• Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through



HIGHLY PREFERRED



• Experience using Stampli or a similar AP automation and invoice-management platform



• Experience supporting a multi-location organization



• Experience with vendor onboarding, W-9 collection, 1099 preparation support, audit documentation, and month-end reporting



• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field



IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This is not a basic invoice-entry, data-entry, or general virtual assistant role.



We are looking for an experienced AP professional who has personally managed the complete accounts payable cycle from beginning to end.



Applicants should be prepared to explain the AP process they handled in previous roles, including invoice review and coding, approval workflows, payment runs, vendor reconciliation, AP aging, discrepancy resolution, and month-end close.



Candidates whose experience is limited to entering invoices or assisting another AP specialist may not be considered. A practical AP skills assessment may be included in the interview process.



We are hiring a full-time Full-Cycle Accounts Payable Specialist to support a growing U.S.-based education organization with multiple locations.



This role is ideal for an experienced AP professional who can take ownership of the entire accounts payable process, maintain accurate financial records, communicate professionally with vendors and internal departments, and ensure invoices and payments are handled correctly and on time.



We are looking for someone who is highly organized, dependable, proactive, and extremely detail-oriented. The right candidate will know what to verify before an invoice is approved, what must happen before a payment is released, how to identify and resolve discrepancies, and what needs to be reconciled afterward.



Key Responsibilities



• Manage the full accounts payable cycle from invoice receipt through approval, payment, reconciliation, and recordkeeping



• Review invoices for accuracy, completeness, proper authorization, correct pricing, and possible duplicates



• Code invoices to the appropriate general ledger accounts, departments, locations, or cost centers



• Match invoices against purchase orders, receipts, contracts, or supporting documentation when applicable



• Route invoices through the proper approval workflow and follow up on outstanding approvals



• Prepare and process scheduled payment runs accurately and on time



• Maintain accurate vendor records, payment terms, tax documents, banking information, and supporting files



• Reconcile vendor statements and research missing invoices, unapplied credits, duplicate charges, payment differences, and other discrepancies



• Communicate professionally with vendors regarding invoice status, payment timing, missing documentation, and account discrepancies



• Monitor AP aging and identify overdue, duplicate, disputed, or incorrectly recorded balances



• Record vendor credits, refunds, adjustments, and voided payments correctly



• Assist with month-end close by reconciling AP balances, identifying outstanding liabilities, and preparing supporting reports



• Support vendor onboarding, W-9 collection, 1099 preparation, year-end reporting, and audit requests as needed



• Maintain complete, accurate, and well-organized AP documentation



• Coordinate with finance, operations, and other departments to resolve AP-related issues



• Identify process gaps and recommend improvements that increase accuracy and efficiency



Requirements



• Minimum 3 years of direct full-cycle accounts payable experience



• Experience supporting a U.S.-based business required



• Strong understanding of invoice processing, GL coding, payment processing, vendor reconciliation, AP aging, and month-end close



• Strong reconciliation, analytical, and problem-solving skills



• Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies before payment



• Strong written and verbal English communication skills



• Ability to prioritize deadlines, follow up consistently, and manage multiple open items



• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while keeping leadership informed



• High level of integrity when handling confidential financial information



To Be Considered, Please Submit



Resume

OnlineJobs Profile Link

Number of years of full-cycle AP experience

Brief description of the AP process you personally handled, from invoice receipt through payment, reconciliation, and month-end close

Approximate number of invoices and vendors you managed each month

List of accounting and AP platforms you have used, including whether you have experience with Stampli

One example of an invoice, vendor, payment, or reconciliation discrepancy you identified and how you resolved it

Short voice recording introducing yourself and summarizing your relevant AP experience



Applications that do not include the requested information may not be considered.



Work Setup



• Full-time, permanent remote position



• Philippines-based candidates only



• Must be available during U.S. business hours



• Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and professional home-office environment required



Compensation



PHP 40,000 per month starting salary



Performance and compensation reviews based on performance, growth, and contribution



Benefits



• Work from home



• Paid training



• Opportunities for advancement and increased responsibilities



• Long-term career opportunity with a growing U.S.-based organization



We are not looking for someone who simply enters invoices and waits for instructions. We need an experienced AP professional who takes ownership, follows every item through to completion, identifies and resolves issues, and helps keep the entire accounts payable process accurate, timely, and organized.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to become a trusted member of the finance team and grow with the organization.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
HIRING: AI Automation Specialist (Full-Time)



Details about the position:



- $1000 to $2000 USD per month!



- Work from home!



- 9AM to 6PM Eastern Time - Monday to Friday!

------------------------

REQUIREMENTS



- Fully fluent in English, both spoken and written.



- Previous experience building automations using Make, Zapier or n8n.



- Previous experience using an AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.



You should be comfortable using coding agents to work on repos inside GitHub, make changes, troubleshoot issues, and confirm that the final result works correctly.



A significant part of this role will involve using coding agents to build and improve reusable skills, instructions, and workflows that will be used by AI agents.



- Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, basic scripts, and AI-agent tools such as MCP servers.



You do not need to be an expert in every term listed above. The more you understand, the better, but we can teach specific tools if you have strong fundamentals.



We do not require you to know how to code, but it is a bonus. You do not need to be a professional software developer, but you should understand how different tools communicate with each other and be able to troubleshoot integrations when something goes wrong.



Preferred, but not required:



- Previous programming or software-development experience

- Experience writing or modifying scripts

- Experience with Google Sheets, Google Forms, Google Drive, Airtable, ClickUp, or GoHighLevel

- Experience with AI image and video tools such as GPT Image, Kling, Seedance, Grok Imagine, or similar models

- Experience with agents such as Hermes and OpenClaw



You do not need experience with every tool we use. We can teach you our specific systems and workflows, but you must already have hands-on experience with AI coding agents, automation platforms, and AI-powered workflows.

------------------------

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



Your main responsibility would be to automate repetitive processes in the company using mainly AI agents, and some Make/Zapier automations as well.



Common examples might look like:



- Building and improving AI-agent skills, instructions, and workflows.

- Automating the generation of AI ads using image/video AI models.

- Automating the onboarding of new clients.

- Automating some of our copywriter's tasks.

- Automating the tracking of all our data.



We already have A LOT of automations + AI workflows set up - you'd be coming into an already existing system. Your goal would be to improve it and keep it up to date.

------------------------

COMPANY INFORMATION



We are a marketing company that specializes in Meta Ads (among other things)



You would help us automate tasks and processes so that we can create more ads for ourselves and our clients!



Last year, we generated over 35,000 leads - you will be contributing to our efforts this year, where we aim to break this goal!

------------------------

So if you're someone who's:



1 - An overachiever

2 - Detail-oriented

3 - Works hard

4 - Proactive

5 - Resourceful



Please apply using this link: b2bscale.pro/automation-specialist-hiring-ojph



When asked what your favorite color is in the application, please put Magenta as your answer, or else you will be disqualified.



Do not send us a message here on Onlinejobs - we do not look at messages. You need to apply using that link and fill out the 5-minute application form. Thank you!

title: Marketing Specialist (Remote) - Casa Oso, near Yosemite
description:
ABOUT US

Casa Oso is a small collection of thoughtfully hosted homes in the Sierra Nevada near Yosemite. Hospitality comes first in everything we do - our guests come for peace, thoughtful design, and the feeling of being genuinely cared for. We already have a clear brand, voice, guest personas, and a marketing plan - so you won't be starting strategy from scratch. We're looking for someone to bring it to life: creating great content and running the day-to-day, warmly and consistently, and helping us grow.



THE ROLE

A hands-on, do-a-bit-of-everything marketing role for a small business. Working from our existing brand and plan, you'll keep things moving across our channels - and help us grow our direct bookings and, in time, our collection of homes. Remote, part-time contractor work (~10 hours a week), with real room to grow with us.



A week in this role looks like:

- Creating on-brand content - writing, visuals, and posts - across our website, listings,
, and social

- Optimizing listing descriptions and visual content across Airbnb, Vrbo, and Booking so they show beautifully and convert

- Managing and optimizing our Google Business Profile

- Light design edits (Canva) to keep everything on-brand

- Small website updates

- Setting up and optimizing Meta and Google ads on a modest budget

- Growing direct bookings, so we lean less on the big platforms

- Spotting homes and owners that could fit the Casa Oso brand, and helping us reach out about managing them

- Tracking results in Google Analytics (with conversion tracking) and a short monthly note



WHO WE HOPE TO MEET

- Marketing experience in hospitality, travel, or vacation rentals (guest-facing a plus)

- Has run the full marketing mix themselves for a small business, on a small budget

- Experience driving direct bookings and reducing reliance on the big platforms

- Comfortable optimizing listings and a Google Business Profile (local SEO a plus)

- A good eye for on-brand design (Canva or Adobe)

- Hands-on with website updates, Google Analytics + conversions, and Meta / Google ads

- Proficient with AI tools (ChatGPT and similar) - using them well to work faster and sharper

- Self-directed and reliable, with warm, clear written English



A FEW PRACTICAL THINGS (worth a read before you apply)

- Independent contractor work: you'll be - or be happy to become - a registered self-employed individual in the Philippines (TIN + BIR Certificate of Registration), handling your own taxes.

- Part-time (~10 hours a week), hours we agree together, paid as a fixed monthly salary, with a warm review after six months.

- You'll work from your own reliable computer and internet.

- Most of all, someone who'd like to grow with us for the long run.



A LITTLE EXERCISE (this is how we get to know you)

Picture one of our homes - a warm, thoughtfully designed place near Yosemite. Write a short, on-brand Instagram caption for it, and add one line on the photo or visual you'd pair with it. A few sentences is plenty - we're looking for your feel for our voice and your eye.



WHAT TO EXPECT

We keep our process warm and clear, so you'll always know where you stand. After we read your application it usually goes: a short note back, a brief video (a few minutes, no script), a video interview, a relaxed meeting with the team, and then an offer. If we'd love to take it further, we'll be in touch - and from that first hello onward, you'll always get a clear yes or no at each step.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply here on OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line: Casa Oso Marketing - [Your Name], and include:

1. Your sample caption + the visual you'd pair with it

2. Your expected pay in USD (hourly or monthly for ~10 hrs/week)

3. The hours and days you can commit to, and your time zone

4. A little about your relevant experience - especially hospitality/travel and direct-booking or small-business marketing - with your resume/CV and a portfolio or work samples if you have them

5. Confirmation you're registered - or willing to register - as a self-employed contractor with a TIN and BIR Certificate of Registration



We read every complete application, and we'd love to meet you.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We’re looking for a strategic and imaginative Creative Strategist to lead the ideation and execution of high-performing ad creatives across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and beyond. This is a cross-functional role that blends storytelling, data analysis, and digital strategy to produce content that drives real business results.



You’ll work at the intersection of creative development and performance marketing—collaborating with copywriters, designers, and media buyers to develop ads that not only look great but also convert. If you’re driven by insights, live for scroll-stopping content, and thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment, we want to hear from you.



Note: This is a passive sourcing opportunity, and while we are always looking to connect with exceptional talent, it may take some time to find the right match for this role.



Responsibilities:



Create strategic creative briefs informed by brand objectives, audience behavior, and past performance.

Lead the ideation and storyboarding of direct-response ad campaigns tailored to paid media platforms.

Collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, and video editors to bring concepts to life with high creative impact.

Monitor campaign performance to identify opportunities for iteration, optimization, or scaling.

Run brainstorm sessions and pitch creative concepts internally or directly to clients.

Stay ahead of trends on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms to inspire innovative creative strategies.

Translate brand messaging into adaptable narratives suited for different formats, placements, and target segments.



Requirements:



2–5 years of experience in a creative strategy or performance marketing role, preferably within an agency or fast-paced DTC environment.

Deep understanding of performance metrics (CTR, CVR, ROAS) and how creative drives outcomes.

Strong conceptual thinking and ability to visually and verbally communicate ideas.

Familiarity with paid media platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google Ads).

Comfortable working in agile, data-driven environments with fast feedback loops.

Light editing/design skills or familiarity with tools like Canva, CapCut, or Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.



This role is part of our passive recruitment efforts, and while an immediate opening may not be available, we welcome experienced and motivated candidates to express their interest. We look forward to connecting with you should a suitable opportunity arise.

title: Senior US Bookkeeper & Agency Partner (Fixed Salary + 50/50 Split)
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY: Own Your Own Portfolio

We are not looking for a traditional "data entry" employee. We are building a high-level US Bookkeeping Agency focused on the home service industry (Chimney Sweeps, HVAC, Window Cleaning, etc.), and we are looking for an Agency Partner to manage and grow their own client portfolio.



COMPENSATION STRUCTURE:

To provide stability while rewarding high performance:



There will be a fixed salary plus a 50/50 split after business expenses.



The fixed salary ensures you are compensated for your administrative and marketing efforts.



The 50/50 split (calculated after a 20% company operating fee) ensures you build long-term wealth as you grow your portfolio.



Income Potential: An organized partner managing a full portfolio of 50 clients can realistically earn $2,500 - $4,000+ USD per month.



YOUR ROLE (The Partner):

Portfolio Management: Perform full-cycle bookkeeping for a dedicated territory of US-based clients.



Accuracy & Deadlines: Ensure all books are audit-ready and 100% completed by the 10th day of the following month.



Growth & Marketing: Utilize our Marketing Vault 
, LinkedIn, and
 strategies) to acquire and manage clients in your assigned territory.



Wholesale Support: Act as the primary point of contact for US-based Accounting Firms (Wholesale Partners) that outsource their back-office work to us.



OUR ROLE (The Agency):

Infrastructure: We provide the GoHighLevel CRM, QuickBooks subscriptions, and all necessary software tools.



Protection: We provide professional liability and cyber insurance for the agency.



Management: Our management team handles technical QA (Quality Assurance) and higher-level administrative support.



Operations: We handle all U.S. legalities, corporate taxes, and ensure your payouts are made promptly via Wise or PayPal.

Volume Experience: Proven ability to manage a high volume of clients (20+) simultaneously without a drop in quality.



Tech Mastery: Expert level in QuickBooks Online (QBO Certified ProAdvisor preferred) and familiarity with GHL or similar CRMs.

title: Instagram Content Growth Specialist  | Luxury Marketing Agency
description:
This is a deliverables-based role, paid monthly.  We care about results, not watching the clock. 

—————



We’re an Australian marketing agency that specialises exclusively in luxury cosmetic clinics.



Our clients are cosmetic nurses, cosmetic doctors, clinic owners and practice managers.



Our own Instagram is one of our biggest marketing assets. We don’t want to simply post consistently. We want to become one of the most recognised marketing agencies for cosmetic clinics in Australia. Every piece of content should help build that reputation.



We’re looking for someone who genuinely loves Instagram, notices trends before everyone else, appreciates beautiful design and knows how to create content that people stop scrolling to watch.



This isn’t a role for someone who simply schedules posts. We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of growing our Instagram account with minimal supervision.



Competitive fixed weekly rate based on experience.



We care far more about quality than quantity.



We’d rather publish one beautiful piece of content than five average ones.



Every Reel, carousel and story should feel polished, intentional and aligned with a luxury brand. We don’t chase content for the sake of posting. We create content that builds trust, stops people scrolling and attracts the right audience.



What you’ll own each week

* Planning our monthly content strategy

* Researching trends and bringing fresh content ideas

* Creating 5 Instagram feed posts per week (mixture of reels and carousels)

* Creating 5 Instagram Stories per week

* Writing engaging, natural captions that don’t sound like AI

* Scheduling content in Metricool ready for approval

* Monitoring what’s working and continually improving our content



We’ll provide:

* Brand guidelines

* A large content library

* Videos and footage when required



You’ll take care of the strategy, editing, design and execution.



The style we’re looking for 

Our brand is:

* Feminine

* Elegant

* Luxe

* Editorial

* Premium

* Modern

* Clean

* Beautiful



Think luxury cosmetic clinics, premium skincare brands and high-end editorial magazines.



If your portfolio is full of generic Canva templates, overly busy graphics or obvious AI-generated content, this probably isn’t the right role.



We are probably a great fit if…

* You save Instagram posts because the design is beautiful.

* You notice typography, colours and layouts that other people miss.

* You enjoy researching trends and thinking, “How can I adapt this for our brand?”

* You take pride in creating content that looks expensive.

* You’re the type of person who tweaks the spacing, animation or timing one last time because you know it can be better.



We’re looking for someone who…

* Has proven experience growing Instagram accounts

* Brings fresh ideas every week

* Researches trends without being asked

* Understands what makes people stop scrolling

* Can create premium Reels and carousels

* Writes captions that sound natural and engaging

* Has exceptional attention to detail

* Can work independently with minimal supervision

* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions

* Wants to build a brand people admire



Please don’t apply unless you have

* At least 2 years’ experience managing Instagram accounts for businesses

* Proven experience growing Instagram accounts

* A portfolio showcasing premium, high-end design

* Advanced Canva skills

* Strong Reel editing skills (CapCut, Edits, Canva or similar)

* Excellent written English

* The ability to work independently with minimal supervision



Equipment required - You’ll need:

* A reliable computer

* Fast internet

*

* Video call capability

* Antivirus/security software



Growth opportunities:

We’re a growing Australian marketing agency. This role begins by managing our own brand, with opportunities to work on premium client accounts, increase your income and grow with the business as you prove yourself.



Trial period:

This position begins with a paid two-week trial.



If we’re a great fit for each other, we’ll move into an ongoing long-term role with regular pay reviews based on performance.



To apply



Please start your application with the following sentence:



“This is (YOUR NAME). I am excited to apply for the Instagram Content Growth Specialist position. Today is (DAY and MONTH).”



Then include:

* A link to your portfolio

* Instagram accounts you’ve managed

* Examples of accounts you’ve helped grow (screenshots welcome)

* Your favourite Reel you’ve created and why you think it performed well



We’re looking for someone who wants to build something they’re genuinely proud of, not someone who’s simply looking for another social media job.



We look forward to seeing your application.

title: Lead Manager / Cold Caller (Land Investing)

• Fill downtime with outbound activity — there is always someone to call

title: Pricing & Vendor Data Coordinator
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who enjoys working with data, creating systems, and keeping information accurate and up to date.



This is not a sales or customer service position. Instead, you'll play a critical role behind the scenes by ensuring our product pricing information is well organized, properly documented, and consistently maintained. If you enjoy spreadsheets, organizing information, creating processes, and catching small details that others miss, this could be an excellent fit.



What You'll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be managing our vendor pricing information and helping us maintain an organized pricing database.



Responsibilities include:



Creating and maintaining a master database of all vendors and the markup rules applied to each.

Documenting pricing structures, including situations where markups vary by brand, product category, SKU, or item type within the same vendor.

Tracking when new vendor price lists are received and recording when pricing updates have been completed.

Monitoring vendors whose pricing has become outdated and following up to request current pricing information.

Maintaining an organized digital library of vendor price lists.

Managing vendor login credentials for suppliers that provide pricing through online portals instead of downloadable price lists.

Identifying missing information or inconsistencies and ensuring they are resolved before they become problems.

Continuously improving the organization of our pricing records and documentation.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is

Exceptionally organized.

Highly detail-oriented.

Comfortable working with large amounts of data.

Proactive and able to follow up on outstanding items without constant supervision.

Able to create and maintain clear documentation.

Strong with spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets).

Able to identify patterns, inconsistencies, and errors.

Reliable and committed to keeping information accurate.

Nice to Have

Experience working with product pricing or vendor catalogs.

Experience maintaining databases or inventory records.

Familiarity with e-commerce or ERP systems.

Experience communicating professionally with suppliers by
.

Which vendors have current pricing?

When was each vendor last updated?

Which vendors still require updates?

To Apply

Your experience with spreadsheets, databases, or data management.

Which spreadsheet software you're most comfortable using.

Your internet speed and computer specifications.

Your expected hourly rate.

title: Push Play LLC — Golf Long-Form Video Editor (Project-Based, Remote)
description:
We are a US-based video production studio that produces premium long-form golf content — full-round course videos with broadcast-style shot tracers, drone coverage, motion graphics, and clean color grades — plus short-form reels cut from the same footage. We shoot in 4K, mostly in LOG, across multiple cameras (cinema, POV/in-cart, and drone). We run a professional editing pipeline with a dedicated sound engineer, and we're now building the same standard for our golf content.



We are looking for one dedicated editor who genuinely knows golf and can make a round of golf look and feel like a broadcast — not a home video.



Who We're Looking For



We want eager editors who genuinely love golf and bring real enthusiasm to long-form content — people who get excited about telling the story of a round, not just cutting clips. Beyond the technical skills, we expect:





No missed deadlines — you hit every delivery date, every time.

Thorough communication — you keep us updated, ask questions early, and never go quiet mid-edit.

Consistently high-quality edits — you hold a professional bar on every video, not just the first one.





If golf is something you actually enjoy and you take pride in your craft, you'll do well here.



This is a long-term opportunity. As we expand further into golf media, we're looking to establish a lasting relationship with the right editor and grow this into a permanent role. We want someone to build with — not a one-off hire.





What You'll Produce (per video)



For each project you deliver:





One (1) long-form 18-hole golf video — 4K, final runtime roughly 45–60 minutes, story-driven and clean.

A custom INTRO on every video — every golf video opens with a built intro (title, hole/course info, branded look). Required on every single video, not optional.

4 short-form vertical reels — cut from the same round's footage (Reels / TikTok / Shorts), 1080 × 1920, up to ~60–90 seconds each.

A clean audio-only export — full-length mix for our sound engineer to master (.WAV, 48 kHz).





Source footage (multicam + POV + drone) is delivered to you via Dropbox.





How Pay Works — It's Not All $250



To be clear up front: $250 is the rate for the full package (one long-form 18-hole video plus 4 reels). Reels bundled with a long-form are included in that $250. When a project is short-form only, short-form reels pay by how challenging the reel is — a simple single-hole course vlog is not the same amount of work as compressing 9 holes into a tight 90-second montage, and the pay reflects that. Here's the breakdown so there's no confusion:



What you're producingPayoutStandard package — 1 long-form 18-hole video + 4 short-form reels$250Simple reel — single-hole course vlog / one-
nt cutdown (light editing)$15Complex reel — multi-hole montage (e.g., 9 holes in 90 seconds): heavy cuts, tracers, graphics, tight pacing$30Reels only — set of 4Quoted by reel type/mix (? $80–$110 for a standard set)Extra reel added onto a long-form package (beyond the 4 included)+$20 each9-hole / shorter long-form (~30 min)Quoted separately (lighter scope)Rush turnaround (under 5 business days)+25%



Every reel-only project is quoted by its complexity, and we'll confirm the payout before you start — so you always know what a given deliverable pays.





MUST-HAVE Skills (do not apply without these)



These are hard requirements. This role is not for a general editor who "can figure out golf."





You understand the game of golf. You know how a round is scored and paced, what a tee shot vs. an approach vs. a putt is, and why certain 
nts matter. You should already know what these mean:



Eagle, Albatross, and Condor — golf scoring terms. Reference: Golf Distillery — Golf Scores (illustrated) and Wikipedia — Par (score). (In your application you'll be asked to explain these in your own words — see the questions below.)







Shot Tracer. You know how to add professional ball-flight tracers and can do it cleanly and consistently. Every tee shot and every approach shot gets a shot tracer. We've found the Shot Tracer app produces the best ball-flight tracking, and we'll provide it if you don't already use it — but there are alternative methods (e.g. tracer workflows in After Effects / DaVinci Resolve), and you're welcome to use any approach that delivers the same clean, professional result.

Color correction / color grading is a MUST — we shoot mostly in LOG. You must be able to convert and grade LOG footage (e.g. Sony S-Log), match color across multiple cameras, keep natural skin tones, and deliver a consistent, professional grade. If you cannot confidently grade LOG, this role is not for you.

Drone footage integration — cutting aerial hole flyovers and transitions into the story naturally.

Motion graphics & golf title graphics — animated scorecards, hole/par/yardage cards, score updates, player-name lower-thirds, and titles that reinforce the 
nt without cluttering it. Golf-specific title graphics (especially scorecards) are a core, recurring part of every video.

Timecoded multicam editing — you can sync and cut timecoded video and audio across multiple cameras and mics accurately.

4K delivery — a computer, internet, and backup storage that can actually handle full 4K multicam editing and export.





Also Required (baseline for every edit)





Burned-in captions (clean, dynamic — a storytelling element, not a plain subtitle track)

Purposeful transitions and zoom/punch-in — energy without overdoing it

B-roll driven from the on-course footage we provide (course scenery, cutaways, player reactions, ambient shots) — not stock B-roll

Sound FX — purposeful golf sound design (clean ball strike, crowd, ambient course, whooshes on graphics) that sits under the on-course audio, never overpowering it

Golf title graphics — scorecards and score updates are required on every video (see Motion graphics above)

A balanced audio mix · consistent color across all angles · natural skin tones · no over-editing





Avoid: excessive effects, overdone zooms, inconsistent color between cameras, effects that feel disconnected from the round.





What We Provide





Shot Tracer app — if you don't already use it, we'll provide access. We've found it produces the best ball-flight tracking; equivalent methods that deliver the same clean result are welcome.

Envato Elements — paid account for music, sound FX, and motion-graphic/title elements (studio work only). B-roll is pulled from the on-course footage we provide — not from stock.

Dropbox — folders for footage intake and delivery

Brand assets — logos, intro/title templates, and reference examples

Direct communication — we run quick questions and updates over
 Messenger with our editing team; it's faster than





What You Provide





Your own editing software (DaVinci Resolve preferred; Adobe Premiere Pro + After Effects welcome — we only receive your final exports, so your workflow is your choice)

A reliable 4K-capable computer, stable internet, and backup storage







To Apply — Please Include ALL of the Following



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed:





Work samples / portfolio — links to your best long-form and short-form edits. Golf work strongly preferred. We specifically want to see: shot tracers, a LOG color grade (before/after if you have it), motion graphics, and drone integration.

Golf YouTube channels you admire — list the golf pages/creators whose editing you like and one line on why for each. This tells us your taste and reference point.

Explain, in your own words, what an Eagle, an Albatross, and a Condor are in golf. (Quick knowledge check — don't overthink it.)

Your shot tracer method — what tool or workflow you use to add tracers, and roughly how long one clean tracer shot takes you.

Your LOG color workflow — which cameras/LOG profiles you've graded (e.g. Sony S-Log3), and how you match color across multiple cameras.

Your software and computer specs — editing software, CPU/GPU, RAM, and your internet speed.

Availability & turnaround — how many golf videos per week/month you can take on, and your realistic turnaround for one 18-hole video + 4 reels.

Start your application with the word "FAIRWAY" so we know you read the full post.







Hiring Process — Paid Trial First



We hire the way we hire our whole team: with a paid trial edit before any ongoing commitment.





After a first review of samples, strong candidates get a scoped paid trial. The trial may include both a long-form golf edit and a short-form edit (shot tracer on each shot, a LOG color grade, a custom intro, scorecard graphics, and a reel), and may run across more than one trial period so we can see consistency, not just a one-off.

The trial is paid regardless of whether you're selected for ongoing work.

If the trial meets our standard, you move into ongoing per-video work at $250 per finished 18-hole video (with 4 reels), with more videos added as our golf slate grows.







Scope of One $250 Video (so expectations are clear on both sides)





1 long-form 18-hole golf video, 4K, ~45–60 min final runtime

1 custom intro

Shot tracer on every tee shot and every approach (a standard round; unusually high shot counts are quoted separately)

Scorecards & golf title graphics, motion graphics, drone integration, on-course B-roll, captions, sound FX, and full LOG color grade

4 short-form vertical reels from the same footage

1 clean audio-only export for mastering

Up to 2 revision rounds included; further rounds or new creative directions are quoted separately

Rush turnaround (under 5 business days) and shorter formats (e.g. 9-hole / ~30 min) are scoped and priced separately







Ownership & Confidentiality



All footage, audio, project files, brand assets, and deliverables are the sole property of the studio and the respective content owner. Work may not be posted publicly, added to a personal portfolio or reel, shared with third parties, or reused, without written permission. Selected editors sign a Non-Disclosure & IP Assignment Agreement before their first paid assignment. Provided software credentials are for studio work only.

title: QA Analyst : ERP & Business Systems URGENT
description:
We're looking for someone who knows accounting and will be a key voice in the direction of the software we create.



At Hutility, we build and support ERP customizations, integrations, automation, and custom software for organizations running on Sage 300 and similar platforms. We're looking for someone who's experienced in the accounting workflows we're building for: someone who can look at what the software does and know whether it makes sense for a real business.



What you'll be doing

·	Review and validate ERP features, fixes, and enhancements by asking whether they make sense from an accounting perspective

·	Follow transactions end-to-end across workflows like AP, AR, GL, procurement, billing, payroll, and inventory, and flag when something doesn't behave the way a real business would expect

·	Work directly with developers and consultants to explain what the expected business outcome should be

·	Document issues clearly: what happened, what should have happened, and why it matters

·	Help the team understand the real-world impact of a bug or design decision on accounting accuracy, reporting, and day-to-day operations

·	Apply structured QA practices over time: test planning, regression testing, defect tracking, etc.



You'll be a great fit if you...

·	Have hands-on experience in an accounting role: AP, AR, GL, payroll, inventory, procurement, or similar

·	Have used an ERP or accounting system in a real work environment (Sage, SAP, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Dynamics, Acumatica, or even Excel-heavy environments)

·	Can walk a developer through what "correct" looks like for a transaction, a report, or a reconciliation

·	Notice when numbers, postings, or workflows don't add up. Even when no error message fires

·	Are curious about how software works and genuinely interested in learning the technical side

·	Pick things up quickly and enjoy figuring things out on your own

·	Communicate clearly: you can make complicated situations easy to understand

title: NOC Engineer
description:
NOC ENGINEER

Net Value Partners — Network Operations Function

Fully Remote | Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST



ABOUT NET VALUE PARTNERS



Net Value Partners (NetVP) is a technology department — an entire technology organization that operates as part of a client's business, not a vendor beside it. Built with an executive strategy layer at the top and six specialized functions beneath it — Cybersecurity, Network Operations, User Support, Project Delivery, Technology Supply Chain, and Business Intelligence & AI — we cover every layer of technology a growing business depends on, and we stay accountable for the outcomes, not just the activity. Our mission is to turn technology into 
ntum for the businesses we serve.



What makes us different is depth. We don't do a little for many — we do a lot for a few. We deliberately partner with a small number of growing, multi-location businesses in operations-critical industries and go deep into their environments, their processes, and their goals. That focus is the whole point: it lets our people truly know the systems and the people they support, rather than spreading thin across hundreds of accounts they'll never understand.



That model only works with the right people, so this is how we build our team. We hire for the long term and invest in people who want to grow with us. Because we go deep for a few clients, the engineers and coordinators here become genuine experts in the environments they own — trusted, recognized, and given real responsibility rather than a queue of strangers' tickets. When our name is on the work, we own it, and every function is named, measured, and accountable. We expect a lot, we support each other, and we operate as one coordinated department rather than a collection of individual roles.



We're headquartered in Naples, Florida, and remote-first, embedded in our clients' workflows wherever they operate. We hold ourselves to a clear set of standards in how we work: excellence as a baseline, continuous improvement, customer-centric decisions, integrity in every action, and strategic, long-term thinking. If you're looking for a place to go deep, build mastery, and stay for the long haul — not bounce between tickets for clients you'll never really know — you'll fit here.



ROLE OVERVIEW



As a NOC Engineer, you are the backend technical backbone of our Network Operations function. You assist the User Support function with complex, infrastructure-level problems and own the proactive operational work that keeps managed environments healthy — patching, firmware and software updates, backup management, network changes, and higher-level troubleshooting. You investigate and resolve i
 escalated from User Support and front-line monitoring, execute approved changes carefully, and escalate systemic or major issues for deeper architectural work with complete context. When infrastructure health is on the line, you own it.



Because we go deep for a small number of clients, you'll come to know their infrastructure intimately — the topology, the history, the failure points — rather than reacting blindly across hundreds of unfamiliar networks. That depth is what lets you prevent problems instead of just chasing them. This is a long-term seat for an engineer who wants to own environments and build real mastery over time.



This is a fully remote, work-from-home position reporting to the NOC Manager.



EMPLOYMENT DETAILS



Work Setup: Fully Remote (Work From Home)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break); occasional after-hours maintenance windows and on-call rotation as required

Compensation: Based on experience

Reports To: NOC Manager

Trial Period: 90 days



ESCALATION MODEL



- Front-line (User Support / monitoring): Monitoring, ticket creation, user communication, and documented first-touch remediation.

- NOC Engineer (this role): Escalated i
 resolution, advanced troubleshooting, patch/backup/network operations, and service restoration.

- Senior / architectural: Major i
, root cause analysis, monitoring architecture, automation, standards, and final escalation.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Escalated I
 Resolution & Support Assist

- Investigate and resolve i
 escalated from the User Support function and front-line monitoring across infrastructure, network, endpoint, backup, cloud, and security platforms.

- Serve as the technical assist for the User Support function on complex, infrastructure-level problems.

- Execute approved remediation procedures and restore service within established service objectives.

- Identify recurring, systemic, or compliance-related issues and escalate for deeper architectural work with complete context.



Patch, Firmware & Update Management

- Own patch management cycles across servers and endpoints — scheduling, deployment, validation, and failure remediation.

- Plan and apply firmware and software updates to network and infrastructure devices during approved maintenance windows.

- Track patch and update compliance, and remediate gaps surfaced by RMM and monitoring tools.



Backup Management & Recoverability

- Monitor backup jobs, investigate and resolve failures, and ensure consistent successful completion.

- Perform restore validation and support recovery tasks to protect recoverability across client environments.

- Escalate recoverability risks and capacity concerns proactively.



Network & Infrastructure Operations

- Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing issues.

- Work with VLANs, trunking, switch port configuration, and Layer 2 switching.

- Troubleshoot Layer 3 routing, NAT, and inter-VLAN communication, plus site-to-site and remote-access VPN and wireless.

- Perform approved network modifications and configuration changes following change-control procedures.

- Support environments using Cisco, Aruba, Adtran, SonicWall, UniFi/Ubiquiti, or similar platforms.



Systems, Cloud & Security Support

- Troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365 infrastructure issues.

- Execute security remediation in the infrastructure and network domain — patching, firmware, configuration hardening — as identified and prioritized by the Cybersecurity function, then confirm completion for their verification.

- Use PowerShell fundamentals and operational tooling to support investigation and remediation.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Own the infrastructure, network, and backend layer — servers, networks, backups, and connectivity — as a peer to the User Support and Cybersecurity functions, not above or below them.

- Serve as the technical assist for the User Support function on complex, infrastructure-level problems, and accept endpoint, account, and device escalations from them with full context.

- Partner with the Cybersecurity function on remediation: Cyber identifies and prioritizes the risk, the NOC executes the infrastructure-side fix (patching, firmware, network changes), and Cyber verifies closure.

- Accept work routed from the Service Desk Coordinator, and route back through the Coordinator when a ticket needs another function or project-level handling.

- Escalate systemic, major, or architectural issues for senior review with complete impact and troubleshooting history.



Documentation & Handoffs

- Maintain accurate ticket ownership, statuses, notes, and resolution detail in ConnectWise PSA.

- Document troubleshooting steps, findings, remediation actions, and escalation notes clearly.

- Ensure senior handoffs include complete impact, troubleshooting history, and recommended next actions.

- Contribute to runbooks and operational playbooks to improve repeatability and service quality.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS



- Escalated i
 resolution rate and SLA / service-restoration performance.

- Patch and update remediation success rate.

- Backup success and failure-resolution rate.

- Documentation compliance and ticket hygiene.

- Escalation quality and completeness of handoff notes.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- 3+ years in an MSP, NOC, infrastructure, or systems support role.

- Experience working from a ticket queue and supporting multiple clients or sites.

- Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, switching, routing, NAT, and wireless troubleshooting.

- Hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, backup/recovery, monitoring, and patch management.

- Strong troubleshooting discipline, documentation habits, and ownership of escalated technical issues.

- Calm, professional, and accountable during service-impacting i
.



Preferred Technical Experience

- MSP platforms: ConnectWise RMM, ConnectWise PSA, ConnectWise Asio.

- Monitoring tools: Auvik, Domotz, PRTG, LogicMonitor, Datto RMM, or similar.

- Network/security platforms: Cisco, Aruba, Adtran, SonicWall, UniFi/Ubiquiti.

- Endpoint solutions: Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Webroot.



Preferred Certifications

- CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+.

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, Endpoint Administrator, or Security Operations Analyst Associate.

- Aruba (ACSA / professional-level), HP ExpertOne, or SonicWall SNSA.

- ITIL Foundation.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal NOC Engineer is a technically disciplined, operations-focused professional with MSP or multi-client experience across managed environments. They are proactive and process-oriented, calm under pressure, and accountable for infrastructure health, recoverability, patching, and clean escalation — the kind of engineer the User Support function trusts to take the hard problems off their plate.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and application to: 

Subject line: Hire Me – NOC Engineer



In your application, please answer these two questions:



1. Our hours are 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST, which is roughly 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time. What do you see as the biggest challenges of working this night shift long-term, and how have you handled them before?



2. What is the most recent thing you learned — technical or otherwise — and what made you go learn it?



All new employees complete a 90-day trial and training period before transitioning to regular employment status.



Net Value Partners · Your Technology Partner in Value Creation

mber to join our team and support our rapid expansion!

), run quotes, follow up like a professional, and build real customer relationships.

• Standard US business hours

• Onboarding hours may vary slightly depending on what works best for you and us

Full-Cycle Bookkeeping: Perform regular bank and credit card reconciliations with 100?curacy.

title: Automation Builder — Business Systems & AI Workflows
description:
We're looking for someone who can take a plain-English brief and turn it into a working automation, inside a client's own tools, not ours. This is real client work: helping small business owners get systems in place so their day runs on autopilot instead of manual busywork.



What you'll actually build

The briefs will already be scoped for you, but here's the shape of the work, and it varies client to client because every client's tools are different. A property management company with a full team needs a shared Slack channel that gets a daily pull of new listings, cross-checked against ownership records, so nobody's chasing paperwork by hand. A small business owner needs their leads landing wherever they already track them (their own CRM, a spreadsheet, whatever they use), tagged, and dropped into a follow-up sequence automatically. A solo business owner wants an assistant that drafts her newsletter, writes social posts, and logs who's shown interest, without her ever touching the automation herself. You take the brief, figure out where it needs to live (the client's Slack, their spreadsheet, their CRM if they have one, Zapier or Make as the connector), build it, test it, and hand it back working.



One rule that never changes: nothing you build lives inside our own systems. Every build lives inside the client's own accounts. You're not maintaining one shared structure across clients, you're building fluently inside whatever each client already uses.



What we need

Real, hands-on experience with automation tools: Zapier or Make at minimum, plus comfort picking up whatever a client already has (Slack workflows, Airtable, Google Sheets, a CRM like GoHighLevel if they happen to use one). Not "I've watched the tutorials." We'll ask for examples.



Comfortable working inside a new client's tools every time, cleanly, without breaking what's already there.

Good written English and good written questions. You'll get a brief and need to ask what's missing, not guess and hope.

Familiar with ChatGPT, Codex and Claude Code as working tools. Several builds will wire AI into a workflow (drafting content, logging and summarizing) not just moving data between apps.



Reliable and available part-time, 10 to 15 hours a week to start, with more hours as client work grows.



How this grows

You start on internal builds, small workflows for our own operations, so we can see clean work before any client's business is on the line. Once you've shipped three clean internal builds, you move to real client work. From there, more hours and first access as we take on new clients.



To apply, send:

Two or three examples of automations you've built, in Zapier, Make, or any other tool, ideally across more than one type of client tool (not just one CRM). Screenshots or a short Loom walkthrough are great.

title: Senior Fashion Photo & Video Editor
description:
Fashion Photography & Video Editing (Senior Level)



Remote | Flexible Hours | Long-Term Position



We're a growing UK-based premium fashion company looking for a highly skilled Creative Production Assistant to support our photography and video production.



You'll work closely with our founders, editing content used across our website, social media and marketing campaigns. We're looking for someone with exceptional technical editing skills, excellent attention to detail and a genuine passion for producing polished, premium-quality work.



This isn't a short-term freelance project. We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship with our business and become an important part of our creative production process.



About the Role



We're looking for someone to become a long-ter
mber of our team.



This role includes a guaranteed minimum of 60 paid hours per month. Our workload is centred around photoshoots and collection launches, so the number of hours required may vary from week to week. Some weeks may be quieter, while others may require significantly more editing, so we schedule work flexibly across the month rather than expecting the same number of hours every week.



If additional hours are required beyond the guaranteed monthly hours, these will be paid at your normal hourly rate.



As our business continues to grow, we expect the amount of work to increase over time. Our aim is to build a long-term relationship with someone who can grow alongside the company, with the hope that this role will develop into a full-time position in the future.



Photography Responsibilities



Working from RAW image files, you will:



Download RAW photographs from Google Drive.

Edit photographs using Adobe Lightroom.

Apply professional colour correction, exposure adjustments and AI Denoise where appropriate.

Produce beautifully polished, premium-quality edits suitable for a luxury fashion brand.

Retouch skin naturally while maintaining a realistic finish.

Remove temporary distractions such as tape, plugs, equipment and other unwanted objects using Adobe Photoshop where appropriate.

Maintain complete consistency across an entire photoshoot.

Follow a creative editing brief and reference images.

Organise edited files using our file naming conventions.

Export JPEG proof images for review.

Once approved, upload the corresponding XMP sidecar files so edits can be applied to our original RAW files.

Video Responsibilities



Working from RAW video footage, you will:



Download footage from Google Drive.

Edit videos using Adobe Premiere Pro.

Colour correct and straighten footage where required.

Match video colour grading to the finished photography.

Remove pauses or unusable sections where instructed.

Organise completed files according to our folder structure.

Upload completed work ready for final review.

Essential Skills



We're looking for someone with:



Excellent Adobe Lightroom skills.

Excellent Adobe Photoshop skills, including advanced retouching and object removal.

Excellent Adobe Premiere Pro skills.

Experience editing RAW image files.

Strong understanding of colour correction, exposure and lighting.

Excellent attention to detail.

The ability to produce premium-quality editing to a consistently high standard.

The ability to accurately follow creative briefs and maintain consistency.

Strong organisational and file management skills.

A fast and reliable internet connection capable of downloading and uploading large RAW photo and video files.

About You



You genuinely enjoy producing beautiful, polished work and have an exceptional eye for detail.



You take pride in consistency and understand that small details matter.



You're reliable, organised and comfortable working independently.



You're looking for a long-term role where you can become a trusted member of a growing business, rather than simply taking on another freelance client.



How We Work



We'll provide a creative brief for every project, including reference images and examples of the editing style we're looking to achieve.



We're looking for someone who can execute that vision to an exceptionally high standard while maintaining consistency across every image and video.



Paid Editing Test



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test.



You'll receive:



Three RAW photographs.

One short RAW video clip.

A written editing brief.



You'll be asked to:



Edit the photographs in Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop where appropriate.

Edit the video in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Return JPEG proof images and the edited video for review.



If your work meets our requirements, we'll then ask you to provide the corresponding XMP sidecar files for the approved photographs.



We'll be assessing:



Overall editing quality.

Attention to detail.

Colour accuracy.

Consistency.

Ability to follow a creative brief.

How to Apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your CV (if available).

A portfolio or examples of your photo editing work.

Examples of your video editing work.

Your internet download and upload speeds.

title: Print & Digital Designer (InDesign Specialist), Part-Time/Full-Time
description:
–––––––– About Us



We create premium print products: wire-bound books, paperbacks, hardbacks, flashcards, and more, selling across multiple channels. We're a forward-thinking design team working at the front edge of how graphic design is changing with AI. We're not looking for someone who wants to spend hours hand-crafting every element from scratch. We want someone fluent in AI workflows, comfortable prompting tools like Midjourney to generate assets quickly, then refining and integrating them beautifully in InDesign. If you want to stay relevant as a designer and work on where the field is actually heading, this is the role.



–––––––– Responsibilities



• Design print-ready products (books, flashcards, documents) in InDesign, with clean spacing, alignment, and usability throughout.

• Use AI image generation tools (Midjourney, Higgsfield, or similar) to create assets, then refine and integrate them into final designs.

• Create infographics, 3D mockups, and listing images for e-commerce.

• Take a loose brief and run with it. For example, turn a rough book outline into a few mood board directions before we develop full pages together.

• Work closely and iteratively. If you're waiting on feedback, shift to another task rather than sitting idle.

• Maintain a refined, modern aesthetic. We want standout quality, not generic templated output.

• Build things so they last: reusable templates, consistent style choices, documented decisions so your work holds up with less direction over time.

• Deliver organised, production-ready InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop files.

• Expect mutual honesty. Ask questions, flag problems early, and treat us as equals.





–––––––– Requirements



• Proficient in InDesign. This is our core software, so you need to be genuinely fast and efficient in it, not just familiar with it.

• Able to take a loose brief and deliver polished, creative options with minimal direction. You work proactively, not reactively.

• Responsive and reliable with deadlines. We work to timelines and need someone we can count on.

• Real experience with print design: typography, layout, usability, spacing, alignment, and consistent colour use.

• Understanding of font licensing and image sourcing, so everything you produce is commercially legal and we have a record of where assets came from.

• A portfolio showing your print and digital work. It doesn't need to be custom-built for this role, just show us what you can do.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken.

• Serious attention to detail. We care more about a perfectly kerned line of text than a fast one. When you apply, start your message with the word INDIGO so we know you've actually read this.

• Comfortable signing an NDA. No sharing of files or concepts outside the team.

• Tell us a bit about yourself too, not just your work. What do you enjoy doing outside of design? What do you spend your time on? We're hiring a person, not just a set of skills.





–––––––– Preferred but Not Required



• Good at prompt engineering. You can brief an AI tool and get close to what you actually wanted.

• Experience creating Amazon, eBay, or Etsy listings.

• Working understanding of Photoshop and Illustrator.





–––––––– The Package



• Flexible working hours.

• Holiday pay and sick pay.

• AI subscription included.

• Access to Skillshare for ongoing training.

• Paid Adobe Creative Cloud subscription from November, once you've passed probation.

• Staggered probation: 2 weeks, then 1 month, then 3 months, with a check-in at each stage.

• A proper contract with a notice period once probation is complete.





–––––––– Hiring Process



1. Portfolio review and interview.

2. 2 to 3 shortlisted candidates move to a paid two-week trial. You'll deliver real work (mood boards, sample pages, etc.) so we can both confirm it's a good fit.

3. A successful trial leads into the staggered probation period above.





Over time we expect you to internalise our style and standards so our direction gets lighter, not heavier. We want someone we can hand a brief to and trust with the details.

title: Software QA Tester
description:
About Us

TYS, S.L.U. is an international company based in the Principality of Andorra. For many years, we have provided crew placement services for the superyacht industry. As part of our continued growth, we have expanded into software development. We currently have one software product in the market, one awaiting its official release, and another scheduled to launch in Q1 2027. We are looking for a QA Tester to help ensure the quality, reliability, and functionality of our existing and upcoming software products.



Job Summary

The role is primarily focused on manual and automated testing. You will be responsible for testing new features, identifying and documenting defects, verifying fixes, and helping improve our testing processes and automation coverage.



The role requires ample JavaScript knowledge and a good understanding of full-stack web applications, as you will test user interfaces, REST APIs, backend services, and overall application functionality.



 What You’ll Do

* Create, execute, and maintain test plans and test cases.

* Perform manual testing for new features, bug fixes, and regressions.

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using JavaScript.

* Identify, document, and track software defects.

* Work with developers to reproduce and troubleshoot issues and verify fixes.

* Participate in sprint planning, feature reviews, and release testing.

* Test REST APIs and backend services.

* Validate UI and UX functionality across different browsers and devices.

* Help improve testing processes, tools, and automation coverage.



What We’re Looking For

* Experience in software quality assurance or software testing.

* Ample knowledge of JavaScript.

* Good understanding of full-stack web applications, including frontend and backend functionality.

* Experience testing REST APIs.

* Familiarity with Git and modern development workflows.

* Knowledge of NoSQL databases.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Must be willing to commit exclusively to this full-time position.



Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Andorra time, with a lunch break from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM.



Salary and Benefits

* Starting salary of PHP 20,000 per month

* Salary increases to PHP25,000 per month after the first month

* In-house healthcare fund after successful completion of the 6-month probationary period

* 20 days of vacation leave per year

* 15 days of sick leave per year

* Philippine holidays observed



How to Apply

If you are interested in software quality, enjoy finding and solving problems, and want to develop your manual and automated testing skills, we would be happy to hear from you. Kindly send us your updated CV. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding the next stage of the hiring process.

title: Meta Ads Video Editor (Ai Proficient)
description:
**Quick Summary**

**Daily Output:** 3–4 concepts per day (with revisions)

**Video Length:** Typically 60–200 seconds

**Focus:** High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

**Location:** Remote



## About the Role



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography, and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content. While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing, and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback. Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing, and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging, and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



## Key Responsibilities



### Daily Concept Production



Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



### AI-Assisted Product Cinematography



Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement, and seamless integration into real-world edits.



### Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration



Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design, and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



### AI Character & Voice Integration



Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers, and emotional delivery when required.



### End-to-End Post Production



Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, color grading, pacing, revisions, and final export delivery.



## Required Technical Stack



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



### AI Video Generation



* Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

* Kling

* Luma Dream Machine



### Voice / Character Tools



* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* D-ID



### Image Generation



* Midjourney v6+

* Leonardo.ai



### Editing & Post Production



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* CapCut Desktop



### AI Enhancement



* Topaz Video AI



## Requirements



### Speed & Efficiency



You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



### Understanding of Advertising



You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling, and what makes ads convert.



### Attention to Detail



You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion, or low-quality visual details.



### Strong English & Audio Awareness



Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers, or direct voice delivery properly.



### Work Ethic & Communication



Communication, reliability, speed, and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



A lucrative bonus structure is available for strong performers.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



* A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work and product ad creatives

* Examples of product b-roll and/or talking character content

* A list of the AI tools you currently use or pay for regularly



### Application Requirement



To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word:



**NEURAL**



## Reference Quality Level



LEVEL OF AI EDITING AND B-ROLL CREATION EXPECTED:
