title: HEAD OF CONTENT Manager & Social Media Strategist (FULL TIME)
description:
Full-time · MUST OVERLAP UK hours required · FEMALE ONLY



About Thuy and The Future Creator

Thuy Le 
 is a British-Vietnamese content creator and professional makeup artist with over 1.9M combined following. Her content lives where makeup, skincare and motherhood meet — the beauty and skincare expertise her audience has followed her for over years, and the honest, real-life side of being a new mum. Her community is women who've grown up with her, many now becoming mothers themselves, who trust her taste and her honesty. You need to genuinely understand that world, because her voice is the brand.



The Future Creator is her new brand: an AI-powered platform that teaches women to build an extra £1–5k a month using content and AI — through simple tools, personalised content plans, and a cohort program we're building now (think a modern, AI-native school for creators). It's for women, especially mums, who want a creative income around their real lives. You'd run the content engine across 
 and The Future Creator, and the systems you build become the model we teach thousands of women.



The role

You are head of content across Thuy's personal brand 
 and The Future Creator. You d
 what gets posted and why, you brief Thuy on exactly what to film so she can just show up and record, and you direct our editors on what videos need to get it made. This is a hands-on manager role: you set the strategy and you run the day-to-day yourself — scheduling, posting, community and graphics are all yours. You report to Thuy and run a weekly planning-and-reporting rhythm, working to an approval flow: ideas approved before filming, posts approved before they go live.



You'll own



Content strategy & calendar across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube for both brands — each platform run to its own best practice, not one strategy copy-pasted three ways.

Forward planning — months of content mapped ahead with full briefs and scripts ready to film, plus weekly brainstorming sessions for future content, campaigns and brand initiatives.

Filming briefs — hooks, angles, formats, scripts, pulled from trend and competitor research, so Thuy just shows up.

The content queue & b-roll library — what's in progress, shot, or missing, flagged before it becomes a gap.

The repurposing system — turning one filmed asset into cuts across YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Reels, carousels and stories, so we get maximum output from every filming day.

Directing editors — briefing, reviewing output, keeping the pipeline moving and on-brand.

Jumping in yourself when a trend needs same-day turnaround — you can edit a quick version faster than routing it through editors

Scheduling, posting & community management across all platforms — responding to comments and DMs promptly and professionally, and coordinating giveaways.

Graphics — thumbnails, social graphics, course slides, carousels (photoshop/Canva/figma required).

Owning the analytics — reading what's working weekly and turning it into next month's content bets (not just reporting numbers, changing the plan because of them), plus a monthly performance report across all social platforms with clear recommendations.

Brand voice — learning and protecting Thuy's voice across every caption, script and member post.

Conversion awareness on content — you know which pieces are conversion plays, you flag when a ManyChat trigger belongs on one, and you route any pre-sale or product question from comments/DMs to Ops so no buyer question slips through. 

Have a clear understanding of
 & creating newsletters with good copy

Shoppable content & affiliate storefronts — keeping the Amazon storefront and LTK (
) updated with shoppable recommendations, and affiliate links accurate across platforms.

Brand-deal pipeline — inbound, deliverables, timelines (Thuy d
 which deals).

Cohort/course content — what gets filmed, scripting, competitor research, member-facing content as we launch.

SOPs & teachable frameworks — documenting everything you run as simple, repeatable systems, so the content engine works without the founder AND becomes the model we later teach our customers. What you build here becomes the product.



EXCEPTIONAL ORGANISATIONAL & CRITICAL THINKING SKILLS REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE.

MUST BE AI FLUENT 



Success in your first 90 days

A live content calendar and queue across all platforms with months of briefs ahead of schedule, a healthy b-roll library with gaps flagged early, steady weekly output through AdClips (plus your own fast-turnaround trend edits), filming briefs Thuy can shoot from with zero back-and-forth, a monthly performance report, and measurable movement on the numbers that matter — follower growth, reach, saves/shares and
 sign-ups driven from content.



You must have



2+ years managing content and at least one person or agency/freelancer — briefing, reviewing, holding deadlines. This is a management role, not a solo content role.

Clear platform-specific strategy knowledge — YouTube, TikTok and Instagram each run differently, and you know how.

Genuine AI fluency — daily use of Claude/ChatGPT (and ideally Descript, ElevenLabs, HeyGen) to research, script and speed up content — and you keep upgrading your AI skills as new tools emerge, not just the ones you know today.

Ability to distil how you work into clear frameworks others can follow — you can teach it, not just do it.

Basic editing ability — enough to jump on a fast-moving trend yourself without waiting on AdClips.

Fluency with Notion, Asana, Slack, and a social scheduler (Rella/Metricool or similar).

Strong written English and a real feel for hooks and short-form.

Graphic design ability — clean thumbnails, social graphics and slides, unsupervised.

Initiative — you spot gaps in the calendar, queue or b-roll library and act, you don't wait to be told.

Understanding of funnels, lead magnets, and how ManyChat triggers connect to content — not building them, but knowing when content needs one.

Utilising Claude Co work/Claude code within your content creation workflow



Nice to have: experience with creator-education or course content, on-camera comfort.



Not for you if: you need a brief for every piece of content, you've never managed another person's or agency's output, or you only plan one week at a time.



How to apply

Start your application with the word CREATOR.



In 3–4 sentences: one content gap or opportunity you see 
 or The Future Creator right now, and which AI tools you'd use to act on it.

In 3–4 sentences: a content project or team you ran end to end — which tool you ran it in, and what you did when someone missed a deadline.

Attach a portfolio or a 1–2 minute Loom, and list the tools you've actually used.



Applications missing the word CREATOR or the management answer won't be read. Shortlisted candidates get a TRIAL task and a live call.

title: Experienced Outbound Sales Representative (U.S. Market)
description:
ABOUT EMK GLOBAL VENTURES



EMK Global Ventures LLC helps home service businesses across the United States capture more opportunities through AI-powered call management solutions.



Our AI Receptionist answers missed calls, captures new leads, qualifies customers, answers common questions, and books appointments 24/7. Instead of losing valuable customers because of unanswered calls, our clients capture more opportunities, book more jobs, and generate more revenue.



Our solution is sold for a $997 one-time setup fee and a $297 monthly subscription. This gives our Sales Representatives the opportunity to earn substantial commissions by selling a premium business solution that delivers real value to business owners.



Our primary customers include Plumbing, HVAC, Electrical, Roofing, Garage Door, Locksmith, Cleaning, and other home service businesses.







WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION.



We're looking for experienced outbound sales professionals with a proven track record of producing results.



If you've consistently generated appointments or closed sales through outbound cold calling, enjoy speaking with U.S. business owners, and are motivated by performance-based compensation, we'd love to hear from you.







YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make outbound cold calls to U.S. business owners.



• Introduce our AI Receptionist solution professionally.



• Build interest and qualify potential customers.



• Guide qualified prospects to our live AI demonstration.



• Schedule follow-up conversations.



• Maintain accurate CRM notes after every call.



• Consistently meet daily activity and performance expectations.







MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



• Must be located in the Philippines.



• Excellent spoken English.



• Minimum 2 years of outbound B2B cold calling experience.



• Experience speaking with U.S. business owners.



• Comfortable making 80-100 outbound cold calls per day.



• Results-driven and highly disciplined.



• Experience using CRM systems.







PAID 2-WEEK PROBATION PERIOD



Every new Sales Representative begins with a paid two-week probation period.



During this period, we'll evaluate your communication skills, professionalism, consistency, coachability, CRM usage, execution of our sales process, and overall performance.



Sales is a performance-driven profession. Representatives who demonstrate strong performance, professionalism, and long-term potential will continue as permanent members of the EMK Global Ventures team.







HOW TO APPLY



We're looking for proven sales professionals—not just people with sales experience.



To be considered, please include ALL of the following information with your application:



• Updated Resume (CV)



• Previous employers (Company name, position, and dates of employment)



• What products or services did you sell?



• Were your customers U.S. business owners or consumers?



• Average number of outbound cold calls you made per day



• Average number of appointments you booked per month



• Average number of sales you closed per month



• What was your monthly sales quota or KPI?



• Did you consistently achieve or exceed your quota? Please provide specific numbers.



• Describe your biggest sales achievement.



• Which CRM systems have you used? (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)



• Please record a 1-2 minute voice introduction in English telling us about your outbound sales experience and why you believe you would be successful in this role.



Applications that do not include the requested information may not be considered.







HIRING PROCESS



Qualified applicants will complete:



• English Interview



• Live Cold Calling Role Play



• Paid Two-Week Probation Period







JOIN EMK GLOBAL VENTURES



We're building a team of high-performing sales professionals who are passionate about outbound sales and delivering real results.



If you have a proven track record, enjoy speaking with business owners, and want to build a long-term career with a growing U.S. company, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply today and show us your results—not just your experience.

We run three companies, we have a CFO, a weekly bookkeeping cadence, and real systems. This is a serious operation, and your work here will be treated as serious. Your talent will not be wasted.



We want A-plus work and A-players only.



=====================================



THE BOOKS YOU WOULD OWN



You would be our only bookkeeper, owning four connected sets of books:



1. Cash Now Philly (wholesale)

2. Off Market Equity (fix and flip)

3. Coffee House Holdings (rentals)

4. Owner's personal books (connected to all three through owner draws, contributions, and transfers between the companies)



=====================================



WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU



- Ownership. You run the entire finance back office, not a slice of it. It is yours.

- Trust, not supervision. You are trusted to run it your way, not watched. Nobody chases you, because you do not need chasing.

- Mastery. Four entities and real intercompany work will make you a sharper bookkeeper than a single-company seat ever could.

- Visibility. Your accuracy is seen at the top. The CFO and the owner know your name and your numbers.

- Real support. A weekly bookkeeping meeting to ask questions directly, a dedicated accounting Slack channel, and AI tools to help you name and categorize transactions fast. You are never left guessing.

- Quiet, focused work. Heads-down, no meetings all day, no rallying a team. Your focus is the point.



=====================================



WHAT YOU WOULD DO



- Record and categorize every transaction across all four books daily, coded to the correct company and account. All G&A, all COGS, all labor and commissions, all marketing.

- Reconcile every account to zero every month across all entities, and keep intercompany and owner flows tied out across the books.

- Enter all bills and invoices and flag due dates to the CFO. You prepare and enter. You do not move money. The CFO approves and pays.

- Track accounts receivable and report weekly.

- Close all four books by the fifth business day and deliver clean P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow reports for each company.

- Submit Ask My Accountant items for anything unresolved.

- Keep the books IRS-audit-proof at all times, every transaction documented and traceable.

- Bring and document your systems so the process is repeatable, and improve what exists.



=====================================



WHO YOU ARE



- Experienced bookkeeper for a US real estate company, across wholesale, fix-and-flip, and rentals

- QuickBooks Online expert, ProAdvisor certification preferred

- Confident with multi-entity books, intercompany transactions, owner draws, and depreciation

- Strong, clear written English

- Honest, precise, and self-managed, the kind of person who owns a clean set of books without being managed



=====================================



THE DETAILS



- Fully remote, work from anywhere in the Philippines

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 1 PM US Eastern, which is 9 PM to 1 AM Philippine time. Four focused evening hours, then your day is your own. This is a night-shift role. Apply only if those hours work for you long term.

- Pay: $10 at 20 hours per week.

- Growth: This starts part-time. For the right person, as our companies grow, the hours and scope can grow too. We would rather grow with someone great than keep re-hiring.

- Reports to the CFO



=====================================



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word RECONCILED so we know you read this carefully.



Then send your resume and short answers to three questions:



1. Describe your hands-on QuickBooks Online experience with a US real estate company.

2. In three sentences, describe how you run a monthly close for multiple entities.

3. Tell us about a reconciliation or categorization error you caught before anyone else noticed, and how you found it.



Strong candidates get a short call with our CFO and a brief, practical QuickBooks exercise: a few real transaction types to categorize and a small set of records to reconcile. It mirrors the actual work. We move fast and we respect your time.



Send your application to

Humpin Hippies (HH Brands LLC) is a fast-growing wholesale wellness brand with a retro-hippie spirit, known for THC-free, vegan, USA-made enhancement gummies (and soon, enhancement honey). We sell B2B into smoke shops, vape shops, convenience stores, adult stores, and an active distributor network across the country.

Performance is tracked against clear KPIs — if the findings and opportunities aren't there, you will be cut from the team.

A sharp-eyed market researcher who can turn competitor and marketplace research into real sales opportunities — not just notes. You'll track competing brands, find new sales channels, and hand off actionable leads to the team. We need someone self-driven who can dig deeper without being chased.

Identify independent online retailers that may be a fit to carry Humpin Hippies.

Record competitor pricing, promotions, bundles, claims, and packaging observations.

Qualified online retailer opportunities.

Competitor seller list and manufacturer/supplier leads.

Competitor pricing and promotional summary.

Top five actionable findings with recommendations for outreach or positioning.

Strong competitive research and analytical skills — proof of work is mandatory, no exceptions.

Comfort synthesizing findings into clear, actionable recommendations (not just raw notes).

Familiarity with marketplaces, wholesale directories, and e-commerce landscapes.

Detail-oriented with good source documentation habits.

Self-directed and accountable to KPIs — surface-level research or missed findings will not be tolerated.





WHY JOIN HUMPIN HIPPIES





Lean, founder-led brand with real growth and direct communication.

Long-term opportunity as we scale nationally.

Location: Remote (Targeting APAC / Southeast Asia)



RD Studio is an international BIM content company known for high-quality Revit families used by thousands of architects worldwide. We are expanding our team and looking for a Revit Family Modeler who specializes in complex, highly parametric content.



** Note **

We are specifically looking for advanced modelers. If you are a beginner or only build basic geometry without nested parameters, this role is not for you).

- Create professional, lightweight Revit families from scratch using nested families, complex formulas, and advanced constraints.

- Maintain strict quality: Follow our internal BIM standards for geometry, parameters, materials, and visibility.

- Draft diverse assets: Work on furniture, plumbing fixtures, lighting, electrical, structural, and more.

- Collaborate efficiently: Manage your workflow using Asana, Google Sheets, and shared QA checklists.

- Advanced Parametric Experience: Proven ability to build highly flexible families (portfolio and .RFA samples are required).

- Technical Mastery: Deep understanding of shared parameters, reference planes, type catalogs, and mathematical/logical formulas.

- Professional Organization: Ability to structure and name parameters cleanly and logically.

- Work Ethic: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and comfortable with English documentation.

- Bonus: Experience modeling MEP or Structural content.

100% Remote: Work from home with flexible hours.

Skill Growth: Get consistent feedback from industry experts to elevate your BIM skills.

Career Progression: Long-term collaboration with the potential to grow into a Senior Modeler or QA Leadership role.

This full-time freelance position is targeted toward candidates based in Southeast Asia (Philippines, Thailand, Myanmar, etc.), as our budget is benchmarked to competitive full-time freelance rates in these regions.

Send an
 to

title: Virtual Sales Manager
description:
JVDB Studios | Amsterdam, Netherlands



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Hours: 20 hours per week to start (Part-Time) with the opportunity to scale to 40 hours per week based on performance

Time Zone: Must have overlap with European/CET business hours

Compensation: Competitive base salary + uncapped commission



About JVDB Studios



JVDB Studios is a media and technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We are the team behind some of the world's largest creator brands, including Kwebbelkop and BlooGaming, which collectively reach more than 15 million subscribers globally.



Our CEO has built multiple successful digital businesses, generated billions of views across platforms, and continues to expand into new ventures within content, technology, licensing, and media distribution.



We are looking for a highly driven Senior Sales Manager / Commercial Lead who can take ownership of revenue-generating relationships across the business and work directly with the CEO to drive growth.



The Opportunity



This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for a proven closer who can build opportunities from scratch, develop relationships with decision-makers, and personally close deals.



You will own the full sales cycle across multiple business lines and play a key role in helping scale the company internationally. This role begins as a part-time position at 20 hours per week. Candidates who demonstrate strong execution, ownership, and the ability to consistently generate and close opportunities will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at 40 hours per week.



We believe in rewarding results. As you help grow the business, the role will grow alongside you.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You will own all revenue-generating relationships across the group, including brand partnerships, media licensing opportunities, FAST and OTT distribution partnerships, DubDash new business development, and creator service partnerships.



You will be responsible for building and managing your own pipeline, conducting outbound prospecting, qualifying opportunities, leading discovery and sales calls, creating proposals, negotiating commercial terms, closing deals, and ensuring a smooth handoff to operations. You will also maintain CRM accuracy, provide regular reporting, forecast revenue, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.



This position reports directly to the CEO with a dotted reporting line to the COO.



What We're Looking For



We are seeking someone with at least four years of B2B sales or business development experience and a demonstrated personal track record of closing consultative, multi-week sales opportunities. You should be able to show real numbers and revenue results from deals you have personally closed.



You must be comfortable owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close and be confident communicating with senior decision-makers across Europe, the United States, and the Middle East. Near-native business English, both written and verbal, is essential for this role.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-motivated, accountable, and capable of building systems and opportunities from scratch. We are looking for a self-starter who can operate independently while maintaining strong communication with leadership.



Candidates with experience in SaaS, media, creator economy businesses, content licensing, FAST channels, OTT distribution, or high-ticket B2B services will be viewed favorably, although these are not required.



This Role Is Not For You If



Your recent career has focused primarily on managing sales teams instead of personally closing deals. You have experience only in appointment setting or SDR roles without a proven closing record. You rely on company logos or network connections rather than demonstrated sales performance. You require a fully built-out system, extensive support, or a large team in order to succeed.



Why Join JVDB Studios



This is a unique opportunity to work directly with a founder who has built audiences of more than 15 million subscribers and multiple successful digital businesses. You will have direct access to leadership, exposure to international clients and partnerships, and the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the commercial future of a rapidly growing media company.



You will work in a fully remote environment with a Monday-to-Friday schedule and collaborate with partners and clients across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. The role offers uncapped commission potential and a clear path from a part-time position into a full-time opportunity for individuals who consistently deliver results.



How to Apply



Fill up this form - wkf.ms/4vgGalP



Applications who have completed the form (answered all questions) shall move forward.

title: HR Specialist - CS Recruitment & People Operations (Clark, Office-based)

About HK 24-BPO



HK 24-BPO is a fast-growing customer service outsourcing company serving cross-border e-commerce brands. We partner with Amazon and Shopify sellers across smart electronics, smart home, wearables, and audio product categories. Backed by our proprietary AI + human customer service system, we deliver reliable, high-quality support to customers around the world. We are now expanding our team and looking for a dedicated HR Specialist to join us in Clark.



About the Job



We are hiring an office-based HR Specialist in Clark, Pampanga. This is not a remote position — you will work from our office and play a key role in managing the full recruitment cycle and daily HR operations for our growing customer service team.



What You'll Do:



- Source, screen, and recruit customer service representatives across multiple channels (OnlineJobs.ph, referrals, social media, etc.)

- Manage the end-to-end hiring process — from posting job ads to scheduling interviews and onboarding new hires

- Maintain employee records, attendance tracking, and performance documentation

- Handle day-to-day HR administrative tasks and employee relations

- Coordinate with the management team in China to align hiring priorities and timelines

- Support training coordination and new hire orientation

- Build and maintain a talent pipeline for ongoing hiring needs

What You Bring:



- 1–2 years of experience in HR, recruitment, or talent acquisition

- Experience hiring for customer service or BPO roles is a strong plus

- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets, job boards, and communication tools

- Self-driven and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment

- Based in or willing to relocate to Clark, Pampanga

What We Offer:



- Competitive salary: $500 – $600 per month

- Office-based position in Clark — stable, professional work environment

- Clear career growth path — grow into a senior HR role as the team scales

title: Mid-Level DevOps Engineer (Production Infrastructure
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a Mid-Level DevOps Engineer with hands-on production experience to review, improve, and productionize our deployment infrastructure.



Our current technology stack: Backend: FastAPI · Frontend: Next.js · Database: MySQL · Cloud: DigitalOcean · Containerization: Docker · CI/CD: GitHub Actions



Much of the initial infrastructure is already in place. Your role is to validate the architecture, identify weaknesses, improve reliability, strengthen security, and ensure our platform is production-ready. You'll take ownership of our production infrastructure, including deployment workflows, monitoring, scalability planning, operational security, documentation, and knowledge transfer.



This engagement will initially be project-based, with the opportunity to transition into a part-time or full-time role based on performance, project needs, and company growth.



Responsibilities



Review and improve the existing production infrastructure

Audit and optimize Docker configurations and containerized deployments

Review, improve, and maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines

Configure and maintain production monitoring, logging, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana)

Configure and optimize reverse proxies (Nginx or Caddy), HTTPS, SSL/TLS, DNS, and networking

Configure and manage CDN services (e.g., Cloudflare) and caching strategies where appropriate

Review and improve infrastructure security, firewall rules, secrets management, and server hardening

Validate backup and disaster recovery procedures

Design and improve deployment strategies that minimize downtime and operational risk

Review infrastructure readiness for ~500–1,000 concurrent users, with a clear path toward 10,000+

Troubleshoot production i
 and recommend long-term improvements

Produce infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, and handover documentation



Required Qualifications



We're specifically looking for candidates with real production experience — not personal projects or tutorial deployments.



3+ years of DevOps, Platform Engineering, or SRE experience

Experience deploying and operating customer-facing production applications

Strong Linux administration; Docker in production

CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar)

Reverse proxies (Nginx/Caddy); HTTPS, SSL/TLS, DNS, networking fundamentals

CDN platforms (Cloudflare, CloudFront, Fastly, or equivalent)

Cloud infrastructure (DigitalOcean, AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Monitoring/observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent)

Production troubleshooting, i
 response, infrastructure security, server hardening

Scalability planning, performance optimization, technical documentation



Preferred Qualifications



Zero/minimal-downtime deployments · high-availability architecture · load balancing · Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi) · Redis/application caching · message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS) · production database optimization · disaster recovery planning · performance testing and capacity planning



What We're Looking For



Someone who understands production engineering principles, not just how to deploy an application. We value engineers who can explain why they make operational decisions, not just how to execute commands.



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, applications that skip this will not be considered:



Start the FIRST LINE of your application with the word ORBIT.



Then answer these three questions in your own words (no AI-generated answers — we will verify everything in a live screen-share interview):



Describe one production i
 you personally handled: what broke, how you diagnosed it, and what you changed afterwards.

When did you last test-restore a database backup, and how did you verify the restored data was correct?

Link to something that proves your work: a CI/CD workflow file you wrote, a live application you operate, or an architecture/runbook sample (redacted is fine).



Applications consisting only of a generic CV or a restated version of this job post will be rejected.

description:
We are a content creator and licensed private investigator brand producing daily video content across multiple niche services. We are hiring one full-time video editor for a long-term role. This position is for one dedicated person only. We are not looking for agencies or multiple contractors.



You will edit short-form vertical videos for YouTube Shorts,
, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Threads, and Pinterest. Short-form content is produced daily across our niches using raw footage we provide. Your work will include adding burned-in captions, hook text, emojis where appropriate, light sound effects, and clean transitions. Edits should be fast-paced, clear, and focused on attention retention without being overproduced.



You will also edit long-form horizontal videos for YouTube and
. This includes trimming raw footage, cleaning audio, adding light B-roll, on-screen callouts, and subtle zooms. For long-form content, we will either provide the YouTube title, description, and thumbnail, or supply them in a Google Doc for you to use. You will upload finished long-form videos to the correct YouTube channels and

All files are organized in Google Drive using a clear folder system, naming rules, and templates. CapCut is preferred, but Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve are also acceptable.



This is a high-volume but structured role with clear instructions and repeatable workflows. Short-form editing is daily, and long-form videos are assigned in organized batches. This is a full-time, ongoing position. We value consistency, reliability, and organization more than flashy effects.



You should have proven experience editing short-form vertical content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Strong English comprehension is required for captions and hooks. You must be highly organized, able to manage bulk content, and able to follow instructions exactly. A reliable internet connection and consistent availability are required. Availability during U.S. business hours is preferred.



Turnaround expectations are same day or next day for short-form edits and two to three days per batch for long-form videos.



To apply, please include examples of short-form videos you have edited, any long-form YouTube examples, the editing software you use, your weekly availability, and confirmation that you are seeking a long-term, full-time role.

This is a hands-on, early-career role. We’re looking for someone with a working knowledge of paid media platforms who’s eager to grow into a more senior marketing role as our business scales.



What You'll Do



• Manage and monitor Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns across multiple markets and brands, including budget pacing, keyword and audience optimization, and search term review.



• Build and maintain accurate reporting on campaign performance, pulling data from Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and our CRM into a consistent weekly format.



• Work alongside our CRM administrator to ensure lead source attribution and reporting stay accurate and complete.



• Flag performance issues or opportunities proactively, with a recommendation attached, not just a number.



• Support ad-hoc requests from ownership and the fractional CMO, including campaign audits, competitive research, and testing new tools or tactics.



What We're Looking For



• Some hands-on experience managing Google Ads and/or Meta Ads campaigns, whether through a previous role, internship, agency experience, or self-directed work.



• Comfortable with data and reporting; you don’t need to be a spreadsheet expert, but you should be able to build a clean report and explain what it means.



• Someone who wants direction and is coachable, not someone looking to work fully autonomously on day one.



• Bonus if you have any exposure to a CRM or marketing automation platform (e.g. GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar).

title: Curriculum Specialist (Curriculum Development and Monitoring)
description:
About Pomelo



Pomelo Academy is an online international school committed to delivering high-quality, globally aligned education through structured instructional systems and strong academic oversight. The institution emphasizes curriculum fidelity, teacher development, and accountable learning processes supported by data-driven monitoring.



Role Overview



The curriculum specialist serves as a curriculum developer and monitoring personnel, ensuring the creation of lesson materials and the integrity of curriculum implementation, consistency of instructional standards, and systematic oversight of the full homework lifecycle—assignment, submission, review, and documentation. The position bridges curriculum design and classroom execution while strengthening teacher capacity and academic accountability systems.



Core Responsibilities



A. Homework System Management (Supervisory Function)



Develop and update homework implementation guidelines



Design assignments, instructional templates, and standardized grading rubrics to be used in classes.



Conduct daily monitoring of the Homework Tracker and Missing Homework lists



Review posted homework’s quality.



B. Curriculum Management



Develop lesson materials for teachers on all subject areas.



Collect EDBs from teachers and develop missing EDBs where gaps exist.



Align and customize trial class EDBs based on student profiles, including differentiated homework expectations, and submit for Curriculum Leader approval



Qualifications



Minimum of five years of ELA/International School teaching experience with demonstrated instructional effectiveness



Experience in curriculum coordination, instructional leadership, or academic operations



Strong background in teacher training, coaching, and quality assurance



Experience working within online or blended learning environments



Excellent organizational, monitoring, and documentation skills



High level of accountability and ability to manage high-responsibility tasks



Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken



Compensation and Work Arrangement



Fully remote work environment (Preferably Afternoon-Evening Shift)



Fixed salary with performance-based incentives



Opportunity to contribute to the development of structured academic systems within a growing international school
